# Introduction

In this RMarkdown file, the final filtered B cell seurat object (obtained in script `012_BCellFiltering_DEGenes.Rmd`) will be used to perform differential gene expression and gene set enrichment analysis, using only the selected cells based on the MiloR differential abundance testing (obtained in script `013_MiloR_DA_FilteredBCells.Rmd`). 

Results were stored in appropriate files

# Soft cuftoff selected cells 

## Differential gene expression analysis - unstimulated vs stimulated

```{r DEGeneAnalysis_8h}
set.seed(2024)

# Initialization of data frame
DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus<-sapply(unique(NBH_Selection_8h.Cells$Stimulation),
                        function(x) NULL)

# Perform DEG analysis
for (stim in names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus)){
  # Select the cells inputted as stimulated cells, cells.2 in FindMarkers() function
  cells.1<-(NBH_Selection_8h.Cells%>%
    filter(Condition == "Stimulated",
           Stimulation == stim))[, "CellID"]%>%
    # Unique names since the cells can be linked to multiple neighbourhoods
    unique()
  
  # Add the annotation as a metadata column to used in the FindMarkers() function
  CellAnnot_Stim.tmp<-rep(x = "Skip", times = dim(IntData.B_8h.FilClus)[2])
  names(CellAnnot_Stim.tmp)<-colnames(IntData.B_8h.FilClus)
  CellAnnot_Stim.tmp[cells.1]<-stim
  CellAnnot_Stim.tmp[NBH_Selection_Unstim_8h.Cells]<-"Unstimulated"
  IntData.B_8h.FilClus$SelCells_DEGAnalyisis<-CellAnnot_Stim.tmp
  
  Idents(IntData.B_8h.FilClus)<-"SelCells_DEGAnalyisis"
  
  # Perform DEG analysis
  DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus[[stim]]<-FindMarkers(object = IntData.B_8h.FilClus,
                                       min.pct = 0, logfc.threshold = 0,
                                       ident.1 = stim, 
                                       ident.2 = "Unstimulated")%>%
    mutate(Score = (pct.1/(pct.2 + 0.01))*avg_log2FC)%>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "Gene")
}
# Cleaning workspace
rm(cells.1, CellAnnot_Stim.tmp)
IntData.B_8h.FilClus$SelCells_DEGAnalyisis<-NULL

# Save the data
saveRDS(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus, 
        file = file.path(params$path_Results, 
                         "DEGAnalysis",
                         paste(params$date2, "DE_AllGenes_8h_PerStimulation_SelNhoods.rds", sep = "_")))
```

```{r DEGenesAnnot}
for (stim in names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus)){
  # Add additional information to the dataset
  DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus[[stim]]<-DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus[[stim]]%>%
  mutate(Annot=case_when(
    avg_log2FC > 1 & p_val_adj <0.05 ~ "UP",
    avg_log2FC < -1 & p_val_adj <0.05 ~ "DOWN",
    TRUE ~ "NS"))
  # Select genes to be plotted as label on the volcano graph
  top20genes <- head(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus[[stim]]%>%
                       filter(Annot != 'NS')%>%
                       arrange(p_val_adj, descending = TRUE), 20)[,'Gene']
  DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus[[stim]]<-DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus[[stim]]%>%
    mutate(GeneLabels=ifelse(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus[[stim]]$Gene %in% top20genes,
                             DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus[[stim]]$Gene,NA))
}

for (stim in names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus)){
  # Add additional information to the dataset
  DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus[[stim]]<-DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus[[stim]]%>%

    avg_log2FC > 1 & p_val_adj <0.05 ~ "UP",
    avg_log2FC < -1 & p_val_adj <0.05 ~ "DOWN",
    TRUE ~ "NS"))
  # Select genes to be plotted as label on the volcano graph
```

## Visualization of DEGenes per stimulation

### Top 20 regulated genes - Dotplots

```{r ExtractTop20Genes_SoftCutoff, fig.width=4, fig.height=10}
#### Extract top 10 genes up- and down separately ####
top20Genes_8h <- lapply(X = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus),
                        FUN = function(stim){rbind(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus[[stim]]%>%
                                                      filter(Annot == "DOWN")%>%
                                                      arrange(Score)%>%
                                                      head(n = 10)%>%
                                                      mutate(Stimulation = stim)%>%
                                                      select(Gene, Stimulation),
                                                     DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus[[stim]]%>%
                                                      filter(Annot == "UP")%>%
                                                      arrange(-Score)%>%
                                                      head(n = 10)%>%
                                                      mutate(Stimulation = stim)%>%
                                                      select(Gene, Stimulation))})
# Place in 1 dataframe
top20Genes_8h <- do.call("rbind", top20Genes_8h)%>%
  mutate(InTop = TRUE,
         TimePoint = 8)

# Extract top 10 genes up- and down seperately
top20Genes_30h <- lapply(X = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus),
                        FUN = function(stim){rbind(DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus[[stim]]%>%
                                                      filter(Annot == "DOWN")%>%
                                                      arrange(Score)%>%
                                                      head(n = 10)%>%
                                                      mutate(Stimulation = stim)%>%
                                                      select(Gene, Stimulation),
                                                     DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus[[stim]]%>%
                                                      filter(Annot == "UP")%>%
                                                      arrange(-Score)%>%
                                                      head(n = 10)%>%
                                                      mutate(Stimulation = stim)%>%
                                                      select(Gene, Stimulation))})
# Place in 1 dataframe
top20Genes_30h <- do.call("rbind", top20Genes_30h)%>%
  mutate(InTop = TRUE,
         TimePoint = 30)

top20Genes_8h_30h<-rbind(top20Genes_8h,
                         top20Genes_30h)



#### Extract data for these genes for each of the stimulations ####
top20Genes_8h.Data <- lapply(X = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus),
                            FUN = function(stim){DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus[[stim]]%>%
                                # Only select the genes of interest as obtained above
                                filter(Gene %in% unique(top20Genes_8h_30h$Gene))%>%
                                # Only select columns of interest for visualization
                                select(Gene, avg_log2FC, Score)%>%
                                # Add metadata column to retain the original stimulation
                                mutate(Stimulation = stim)})%>%
  # Paste dataframes stored in list
  do.call(what = "rbind")%>%
  # Indicate if in top20 in specific stimulation
  left_join(y = top20Genes_8h,
            by = join_by(Gene, Stimulation))%>%
  mutate(TimePoint = 8)

top20Genes_30h.Data <- lapply(X = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus),
                            FUN = function(stim){DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus[[stim]]%>%
                                # Only select the genes of interest as obtained above
                                filter(Gene %in% unique(top20Genes_8h_30h$Gene))%>%
                                # Only select columns of interest for visualization
                                select(Gene, avg_log2FC, Score)%>%
                                # Add metadata column to retain the original stimulation
                                mutate(Stimulation = stim)})%>%
  # Paste dataframes stored in list
  do.call(what = "rbind")%>%
  # Indicate if in top20 in specific stimulation
  left_join(y = top20Genes_30h,
            by = join_by(Gene, Stimulation))%>%
  mutate(TimePoint = 30)

#### Combine 8 and 30 hours ####
top20Genes_8h_30h.Data <- rbind(top20Genes_8h.Data,
                                top20Genes_30h.Data)
top20Genes_8h_30h.Data[is.na(top20Genes_8h_30h.Data$InTop), "InTop"]<-FALSE 
# Reordering of columns
top20Genes_8h_30h.Data<-top20Genes_8h_30h.Data%>%
  mutate(Gene = fct_reorder(Gene, avg_log2FC),
         Stimulation = factor(Stimulation,
                              levels = c("ODN2006", "IFNgamma", "MegaCD40L", "antiCD3CD28"),
                              order = T),
         TimePoint = factor(TimePoint,
                            levels = c(8,30),
                            ordered = T))

# PlotData
ggplot(top20Genes_8h_30h.Data,
       mapping = aes(x = Stimulation,
                     y = Gene,
                     size = abs(Score),
                     color = avg_log2FC,
                     shape = InTop))+
  facet_grid(.~TimePoint)+
  geom_hline(mapping = aes(yintercept = Gene),
             color = "grey80", 
             alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_vline(mapping = aes(xintercept = Stimulation),
             color = "grey80",
             alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_point()+
  scale_color_gradient2(low = colDirection["DOWN"], 
                        mid = "white", 
                        high = colDirection["UP"],
                        midpoint = 0)+
  scale_size(range = c(1,6))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 16,
                                "FALSE" = 1))+
  themeG+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   vjust = 1, hjust = 0), 
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank())+
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top")+
  ggtitle("Top 20 genes based on soft-cutoffs - 8h")
```

### Upsetplot

This visualization strategy is similar to what is performed in script `011_DEGenes_Visulaization_GSEAOverlap.Rmd`, to check the overlap in differentially expressed genes between stimulatory conditions.

```{r UpsetPlotVisualzation_OverlapDEGenes_8h, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
# Only focus on significantly different genes
UpsetData_SIGN <- list("IFNgamma" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus$IFNgamma%>%
                                 filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"], 
                     "MegaCD40L" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus$MegaCD40L%>%
                                      filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"], 
                     "ODN2006" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus$ODN2006%>%
                                    filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"],
                     "CD3CD28" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus$antiCD3CD28%>%
                                    filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"]) 
# Generation of list of downregulated genes per 
UpsetData_SIGN <- list_to_matrix(UpsetData_SIGN)
# Generation of comb_mat object
UpsetData_SIGN <- make_comb_mat(UpsetData_SIGN, mode = "distinct")
# Generation of the plot
UpSet(UpsetData_SIGN, comb_order = order(comb_size(UpsetData_SIGN), decreasing = T),
      comb_col = "#595B5C", bg_pt_col = "white",
      column_title = "Overlap significant DE genes",
      right_annotation = rowAnnotation(
                "DE genes" = anno_barplot(set_size(UpsetData_SIGN),
                                          border = FALSE,
                                          gp = gpar(fill = "#595B5C",
                                                    lty = "blank"), 
                                          add_numbers = T,
                                          width = unit(4, "cm"))),
      top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
                "Intersection size" = anno_barplot(comb_size(UpsetData_SIGN),
                                                   border = FALSE,
                                                   gp = gpar(fill = "#595B5C",
                                                             lty = "blank"), 
                                                   add_numbers = T,
                                                   height = unit(4, "cm")),
                annotation_name_side = "left",
                annotation_name_rot = 90))
```

```{r UpsetPlotVisualzation_OverlapDEGenes_Advanced, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
### GENERATE DATA FRAMES NEEDED TO PLOT DATA ###
# Filter out the genes of interest in 2 different sets
UpsetData_COMB <- c(lapply(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus, FUN = function(stim){(stim%>%
                                                                          filter(Annot == "UP"))[, "Gene"]}),
                       lapply(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus, FUN = function(stim){(stim%>%
                                                                          filter(Annot == "DOWN"))[, "Gene"]}))
names(UpsetData_COMB)<- paste(names(UpsetData_COMB), rep(c("UP", "DOWN"), each = 4), sep = "_")


# Generation of list of downregulated genes per 
UpsetData_COMB <- as.data.frame(list_to_matrix(UpsetData_COMB))

# Check if the expression change is consistent between stimulations
UpsetData_COMB<-UpsetData_COMB%>%
  mutate_at(vars(ends_with("UP")), function(x){ifelse(x==1, "UP", NA)})%>%
  mutate_at(vars(ends_with("DOWN")), function(x){ifelse(x==1, "DOWN", NA)})

# Check if the genes were upregulated/downregulated/mixed over the distinct subsets 
UpsetData_COMB$Direction<-apply(UpsetData_COMB, 1, function(col) {
  u <- unique(na.omit(col))
  if (length(u) == 1) {
    # either "UP" or "DOWN"
    return(u)
  } else if (length(u) > 1) {
    return("MIXED")
  } else {
    # no non-NA values
    return(NA_character_)
  }
})

# Store the genes linked to specific subsets
# stack function creates a data frame from a list
Subsets<-stack(sapply(X = comb_name(UpsetData_SIGN),
                      FUN = function(subset){extract_comb(UpsetData_SIGN, subset)}))
colnames(Subsets) <- c("Genes", "Subset")
UpsetData_COMB <- left_join(x = UpsetData_COMB%>%
                              rownames_to_column(var = "Genes"),
                            y = Subsets,
                            by = "Genes")%>%
  mutate(Direction = factor(Direction, levels = c("MIXED", "UP", "DOWN"),
                               ordered = T))

# Store the table of the distinct directions
UpsetData_COMB.table<-table(UpsetData_COMB$Subset,
                            UpsetData_COMB$Direction)
```

```{r PlotUpset_DEGenes, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
                "DE genes" = anno_barplot(set_size(UpsetData_SIGN),
                                          border = FALSE,
                                          gp = gpar(fill = "#595B5C",
                                                    lty = "blank"), 
                                          add_numbers = T,
```

```{r UpsetPlotVisualzation_OverlapDEGenes_Advanced, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
### GENERATE DATA FRAMES NEEDED TO PLOT DATA ###
# Filter out the genes of interest in 2 different sets
UpsetData_COMB_30h <- c(lapply(DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus, FUN = function(stim){(stim%>%
                                                                          filter(Annot == "UP"))[, "Gene"]}),
                       lapply(DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus, FUN = function(stim){(stim%>%
                                                                          filter(Annot == "DOWN"))[, "Gene"]}))
names(UpsetData_COMB_30h)<- paste(names(UpsetData_COMB_30h), rep(c("UP", "DOWN"), each = 4), sep = "_")


# Generation of list of downregulated genes per 
UpsetData_COMB_30h <- as.data.frame(list_to_matrix(UpsetData_COMB_30h))

# Check if the expression change is consistent between stimulations
UpsetData_COMB_30h<-UpsetData_COMB_30h%>%
  mutate_at(vars(ends_with("UP")), function(x){ifelse(x==1, "UP", NA)})%>%
  mutate_at(vars(ends_with("DOWN")), function(x){ifelse(x==1, "DOWN", NA)})

# Check if the genes were upregulated/downregulated/mixed over the distinct subsets 
UpsetData_COMB_30h$Direction<-apply(UpsetData_COMB_30h, 1, function(col) {
  u <- unique(na.omit(col))
  if (length(u) == 1) {
    # either "UP" or "DOWN"
    return(u)
  } else if (length(u) > 1) {
    return("MIXED")
  } else {
    # no non-NA values
    return(NA_character_)
  }
})

# Store the genes linked to specific subsets
# stack function creates a data frame from a list
Subsets_30h<-stack(sapply(X = comb_name(UpsetData_SIGN_30h),
                      FUN = function(subset){extract_comb(UpsetData_SIGN_30h, subset)}))
colnames(Subsets_30h) <- c("Genes", "Subset")
UpsetData_COMB_30h <- left_join(x = UpsetData_COMB_30h%>%
                              rownames_to_column(var = "Genes"),
                            y = Subsets_30h,
                            by = "Genes")%>%
  mutate(Direction = factor(Direction, levels = c("MIXED", "UP", "DOWN"),
                               ordered = T))

# Store the table of the distinct directions
UpsetData_COMB_30h.table<-table(UpsetData_COMB_30h$Subset,
                            UpsetData_COMB_30h$Direction)
```

## Hypergeometric testing of gene set enrichment 
Statistical testing of the enrichment of specific gene sets within the unique or overlapping genes will be performed using a hypergeometric statistical testing (HGT) approach. Under the hood, it is actually similar to the one-sided Fisher's exact test based on the contingency table between genes present or absent in the gene set of interest. More information in this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bN2OakOqOQI&list=PL1TwkRAGtllLe_bhend9-dzKToOxLuObm).

The approach followed is described [here](https://montilab.github.io/BS831/articles/docs/HyperEnrichment.html) and written down in more detail in my notes (see Remarkable).

### Interesting gene sets
The gene sets of interest were obtained via the MSig database and based on multiple articles such as

- https://www.frontiersin.orghttps://www.frontiersin.org/journals/immunology/articles/10.3389/fimmu.2021.602539/full
- https://www.gsea-msigdb.org/gsea/msigdb/human/collections.jsp#C8

Two gene sets are used that could be of interest for this analysis

- MSigDB, category 5: Gene ontology gene sets (subcategory Biological Processes)
- MSigDB, category 7: Immunologic signature gene sets

```{r GeneSetExtraction}
# Gene ontology - Biological processes
GeneSets_GO_BP<-msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C5", subcategory = "BP")%>%
  # Select only the columns of interest for downstream analysis
  select(gs_name, gene_symbol, gs_description)

# Make sure no duplicates of genes are retained in the genesets
GeneSets_GO_BP<-GeneSets_GO_BP%>%
  subset(!duplicated(GeneSets_GO_BP[, c("gs_name", "gene_symbol")]))

# Select only the genes that are present in our dataset
GeneSets_GO_BP<-GeneSets_GO_BP%>%
  filter(gene_symbol %in% DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus$IFNgamma[["Gene"]])
```


### `phyper` HGT testing

#### 8h stimulation

```{r Phyper_HGT_GOSets_8h}
# Save the total number of genes in the entire dataset
totalGeneNumber<-length(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus$IFNgamma$Gene)

# Initialization of dataframa that will be filled in using the following code
GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=length(unique(GeneSets_GO_BP$gs_name)),ncol=1))
GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h$GeneSet <-unique(GeneSets_GO_BP$gs_name)
GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h<- GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h%>%column_to_rownames(var = "GeneSet")


# For-loop over the pathways of interest
for (pathway in GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h%>%rownames()){
  # Extract the genes of the pathway of interest
  pathway.genes<-(GeneSets_GO_BP%>%filter(gs_name == pathway))[['gene_symbol']]
  
  # For-loop over the distinct subsets
  for(stim in names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus)){
           # Initialization of names
           overlapUP.var<-paste("Overlap",stim, "UP", sep = "_")
           overlapUP.pval<-paste("pval", stim, "UP", sep = "_")
           overlapDOWN.var<-paste("Overlap",stim, "DOWN", sep = "_")
           overlapDOWN.pval<-paste("pval", stim, "DOWN", sep = "_")
           # Extract subset of interest
           subsetUP<-(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus[[stim]]%>%
             filter(Annot == "UP"))[["Gene"]]
           subsetDOWN<-(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus[[stim]]%>%
             filter(Annot == "DOWN"))[["Gene"]]
           # Check overlap + store in the final dataframe
           overlapUP<-length(intersect(pathway.genes, subsetUP))
           GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h[pathway, overlapUP.var]<-overlapUP
           overlapDOWN<-length(intersect(pathway.genes, subsetDOWN))
           GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h[pathway, overlapDOWN.var]<-overlapDOWN
           
           # Perform hypergeometric testing for upregulated genes
           GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h[pathway, overlapUP.pval]<-phyper(q = overlapUP - 1,
                                                       m = length(pathway.genes),
                                                       n = totalGeneNumber-length(pathway.genes),
                                                       k = length(subsetUP),
                                                       lower.tail = F)
           # Perform hypergeometric testing for downregulated genes
           GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h[pathway, overlapDOWN.pval]<-phyper(q = overlapDOWN - 1,
                                                       m = length(pathway.genes),
                                                       n = totalGeneNumber-length(pathway.genes),
                                                       k = length(subsetDOWN),
                                                       lower.tail = F)
           }
}

# Remove the unnecessary columns
GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h[["V1"]]<-NULL
```

```{r IncubTime_Phyper_HGT_MultipleTestingCorrection_GOSets_PerStim}
# Multiple testing correction with Benjamini Hochberg
for(col in grep(pattern = "^pval", x = names(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h), value = T)){
  new_colname <- paste0('adj', col)
  GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h[,new_colname] <- p.adjust(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h[,col], method = "BH")
}

GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h%>%head()
```

```{r IncubTime_Phyper_HGT_Vis_Pval_Overview, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
print("GO gene sets - 8h")
sapply(X = grep(pattern = "adjpval", x = names(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h), value = T),
       FUN = function(subset){
         sum(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h[[subset]]<=0.05)
       })
```

## Visualization of interesting genesets

### Heatmaps

```{r IncubTime_GSEA_PerStim_Heatmap_8h, fig.height=15, fig.width=10}
# Extracting the most interesting gene sets based on the top 20 per subset
for (stim_dir in grep(pattern = "adjpval", x = names(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h), value = T)){
  top20GSE_stim <- head(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h%>%
                          # Only extract the top 10 of the upregulated genes
                       arrange(.data[[stim_dir]]), n = 10)%>%rownames
  
  # Store only the top 10 down/upregulated gene sets in a dataframe
  # First check if the dataframe is does exist or is empyt
  if (!exists("top20GSE_total.8h") || length(top20GSE_total.8h) == 0){
    message("Creating vector")
    top20GSE_total.8h <- top20GSE_stim
  } else {
    message("\nJoining additional gene sets")
    # Adding additional gene sets if they are not yet present in the top20GSE list
   top20GSE_total.8h <- unique(c(top20GSE_total.8h, top20GSE_stim))
  }
}

#### HEATMAP ####
# Extracting plot matrix necessary for heatmap generation
plotData <- (GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h[top20GSE_total.8h,]%>%
  select(starts_with("adjpval"))%>%
  as.matrix()%>%
  log10())*(-1)
rownames(plotData)<-gsub(x = rownames(plotData), pattern = "GOBP_", replacement = "")

# Plot the heatmap
Heatmap(matrix = plotData,
        row_names_side = "left", column_names_side = "top",
        show_row_dend = F, show_column_dend = F, 
        row_dend_reorder = T, column_dend_reorder = T,
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
        row_names_rot = -45,
        name = "-log10(adj_pval)",
        col = colorRamp2(c(0, 5, 80), c("white", "lightblue", "darkblue")))
```

```{r DotPlot_GSEA_Visualization_8h_30h, fig.height=15, fig.width=15}
    # Transform to longer format

    mutate(Stimulation = gsub(pattern = "Overlap_", replacement = "", Stimulation)),

    # Mark that these are the values for 8 hours of stimulation

    # Transform to longer format
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("adjpval"),

    mutate(Stimulation = gsub(pattern = "adjpval_", replacement = "", Stimulation)),
  # Extract the overlap

    # Mark that these are the values for 8 hours of stimulation
    mutate(TimePoint = 30)

  scale_x_discrete(position = "top")+
  facet_grid(.~TimePoint)+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank()))+
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 6))+ 
  plot_annotation(title = "Soft Cutoffs for Nhood selection")
```

# Hard cuftoff selected cells 

## Differential gene expression analysis - unstimulated vs stimulated

```{r DEGeneAnalysis_8h_Fixed}
set.seed(2024)

# Initialization of data frame
DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed<-sapply(unique(NBH_Selection_8h.Fixed.Cells$Stimulation),
                        function(x) NULL)

# Perform DEG analysis
for (stim in names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed)){
  # Select the cells inputted as stimulated cells, cells.2 in FindMarkers() function
  cells.1<-(NBH_Selection_8h.Fixed.Cells%>%
    filter(Condition == "Stimulated",
           Stimulation == stim))[, "CellID"]%>%
    # Unique names since the cells can be linked to multiple neighbourhoods
    unique()
  
  # Add the annotation as a metadata column to used in the FindMarkers() function
  CellAnnot_Stim.tmp<-rep(x = "Skip", times = dim(IntData.B_8h.FilClus)[2])
  names(CellAnnot_Stim.tmp)<-colnames(IntData.B_8h.FilClus)
  CellAnnot_Stim.tmp[cells.1]<-stim
  CellAnnot_Stim.tmp[NBH_Selection_Unstim_8h.Fixed.Cells]<-"Unstimulated"
  IntData.B_8h.FilClus$SelCells_DEGAnalyisis<-CellAnnot_Stim.tmp
  
  Idents(IntData.B_8h.FilClus)<-"SelCells_DEGAnalyisis"
  
  # Perform DEG analysis
  DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]<-FindMarkers(object = IntData.B_8h.FilClus,
                                       min.pct = 0, logfc.threshold = 0,
                                       ident.1 = stim, 
                                       ident.2 = "Unstimulated")%>%
    mutate(Score = (pct.1/(pct.2 + 0.01))*avg_log2FC)%>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "Gene")
}
# Cleaning workspace
rm(cells.1, CellAnnot_Stim.tmp)
IntData.B_8h.FilClus$SelCells_DEGAnalyisis<-NULL

# Save the data
saveRDS(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed, 
        file = file.path(params$path_Results, 
                         "DEGAnalysis",
                         paste(params$date2, "DE_AllGenes_8h_PerStimulation_SelNhoods_HardCutOff3.5.rds", sep = "_")))
```

```{r DEGenesAnnot_Fixed}
for (stim in names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed)){
  # Add additional information to the dataset
  DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]<-DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]%>%
  mutate(Annot=case_when(
    avg_log2FC > 1 & p_val_adj <0.05 ~ "UP",
    avg_log2FC < -1 & p_val_adj <0.05 ~ "DOWN",
    TRUE ~ "NS"))
  # Select genes to be plotted as label on the volcano graph
  top20genes <- head(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]%>%
                       filter(Annot != 'NS')%>%
                       arrange(p_val_adj, descending = TRUE), 20)[,'Gene']
  DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]<-DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]%>%
    mutate(GeneLabels=ifelse(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]$Gene %in% top20genes,
                             DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]$Gene,NA))
}
```

### Top 20 regulated genes - Dotplots

```{r ExtractTop20Genes_HardCutoff, fig.width=4, fig.height=10}
#### Extract top 10 genes up- and down separately ####
top20Genes_8h.Fixed <- lapply(X = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed),
                        FUN = function(stim){rbind(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]%>%
                                                      filter(Annot == "DOWN")%>%
                                                      arrange(Score)%>%
                                                      head(n = 10)%>%
                                                      mutate(Stimulation = stim)%>%
                                                      select(Gene, Stimulation),
                                                     DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]%>%
                                                      filter(Annot == "UP")%>%
                                                      arrange(-Score)%>%
                                                      head(n = 10)%>%
                                                      mutate(Stimulation = stim)%>%
                                                      select(Gene, Stimulation))})
# Place in 1 dataframe
top20Genes_8h.Fixed <- do.call("rbind", top20Genes_8h.Fixed)%>%
  mutate(InTop = TRUE,
         TimePoint = 8)

# Extract top 10 genes up- and down seperately
top20Genes_30h.Fixed <- lapply(X = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed),
                        FUN = function(stim){rbind(DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]%>%
                                                      filter(Annot == "DOWN")%>%
                                                      arrange(Score)%>%
                                                      head(n = 10)%>%
                                                      mutate(Stimulation = stim)%>%
                                                      select(Gene, Stimulation),
                                                     DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]%>%
                                                      filter(Annot == "UP")%>%
                                                      arrange(-Score)%>%
                                                      head(n = 10)%>%
                                                      mutate(Stimulation = stim)%>%
                                                      select(Gene, Stimulation))})
# Place in 1 dataframe
top20Genes_30h.Fixed <- do.call("rbind", top20Genes_30h.Fixed)%>%
  mutate(InTop = TRUE,
         TimePoint = 30)

top20Genes_8h_30h.Fixed<-rbind(top20Genes_8h.Fixed,
                               top20Genes_30h.Fixed)



#### Extract data for these genes for each of the stimulations ####
top20Genes_8h.Data.Fixed <- lapply(X = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed),
                            FUN = function(stim){DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]%>%
                                # Only select the genes of interest as obtained above
                                filter(Gene %in% unique(top20Genes_8h_30h.Fixed$Gene))%>%
                                # Only select columns of interest for visualization
                                select(Gene, avg_log2FC, Score)%>%
                                # Add metadata column to retain the original stimulation
                                mutate(Stimulation = stim)})%>%
  # Paste dataframes stored in list
  do.call(what = "rbind")%>%
  # Indicate if in top20 in specific stimulation
  left_join(y = top20Genes_8h,
            by = join_by(Gene, Stimulation))%>%
  mutate(TimePoint = 8)

top20Genes_30h.Data.Fixed <- lapply(X = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed),
                            FUN = function(stim){DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]%>%
                                # Only select the genes of interest as obtained above
                                filter(Gene %in% unique(top20Genes_8h_30h.Fixed$Gene))%>%
                                # Only select columns of interest for visualization
                                select(Gene, avg_log2FC, Score)%>%
                                # Add metadata column to retain the original stimulation
                                mutate(Stimulation = stim)})%>%
  # Paste dataframes stored in list
  do.call(what = "rbind")%>%
  # Indicate if in top20 in specific stimulation
  left_join(y = top20Genes_30h,
            by = join_by(Gene, Stimulation))%>%
  mutate(TimePoint = 30)

#### Combine 8 and 30 hours ####
top20Genes_8h_30h.Data.Fixed <- rbind(top20Genes_8h.Data.Fixed,
                                top20Genes_30h.Data.Fixed)
top20Genes_8h_30h.Data.Fixed[is.na(top20Genes_8h_30h.Data.Fixed$InTop), "InTop"]<-FALSE 
# Reordering of columns
top20Genes_8h_30h.Data<-top20Genes_8h_30h.Data.Fixed%>%
  mutate(Gene = fct_reorder(Gene, avg_log2FC),
         Stimulation = factor(Stimulation,
                              levels = c("ODN2006", "IFNgamma", "MegaCD40L", "antiCD3CD28"),
                              order = T),
         TimePoint = factor(TimePoint,
                            levels = c(8,30),
                            ordered = T))

# PlotData
ggplot(top20Genes_8h_30h.Data.Fixed,
       mapping = aes(x = Stimulation,
                     y = Gene,
                     size = abs(Score),
                     color = avg_log2FC,
                     shape = InTop))+
  facet_grid(.~TimePoint)+
  geom_hline(mapping = aes(yintercept = Gene),
             color = "grey80", 
             alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_vline(mapping = aes(xintercept = Stimulation),
             color = "grey80",
             alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_point()+
  scale_color_gradient2(low = colDirection["DOWN"], 
                        mid = "white", 
                        high = colDirection["UP"],
                        midpoint = 0)+
  scale_size(range = c(1,6))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 16,
                                "FALSE" = 1))+
  themeG+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   vjust = 1, hjust = 0), 
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank())+
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top")+
  ggtitle("Top 20 genes based on soft-cutoffs - 8h")
```

### Upset plot

This visualization strategy is similar to what is performed in script `011_DEGenes_Visulaization_GSEAOverlap.Rmd`, to check the overlap in differentially expressed genes between stimulatory conditions.

#### 8h stimulation

```{r UpsetPlotVisualzation_OverlapDEGenes_8h_Fixed, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
# Only focus on significantly different genes
UpsetData_SIGN.Fixed <- list("IFNgamma" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed$IFNgamma%>%
                                 filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"], 
                     "MegaCD40L" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed$MegaCD40L%>%
                                      filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"], 
                     "ODN2006" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed$ODN2006%>%
                                    filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"],
                     "CD3CD28" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed$antiCD3CD28%>%
                                    filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"]) 
# Generation of list of downregulated genes per 
UpsetData_SIGN.Fixed <- list_to_matrix(UpsetData_SIGN.Fixed)
# Generation of comb_mat object
UpsetData_SIGN.Fixed <- make_comb_mat(UpsetData_SIGN.Fixed, mode = "distinct")
# Generation of the plot
UpSet(UpsetData_SIGN.Fixed, comb_order = order(comb_size(UpsetData_SIGN.Fixed), decreasing = T),
      comb_col = "#595B5C", bg_pt_col = "white",
      column_title = "Overlap significant DE genes",
      right_annotation = rowAnnotation(
                "DE genes" = anno_barplot(set_size(UpsetData_SIGN.Fixed),
                                          border = FALSE,
                                          gp = gpar(fill = "#595B5C",
                                                    lty = "blank"), 
                                          add_numbers = T,
                                          width = unit(4, "cm"))),
      top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
                "Intersection size" = anno_barplot(comb_size(UpsetData_SIGN.Fixed),
                                                   border = FALSE,
                                                   gp = gpar(fill = "#595B5C",
                                                             lty = "blank"), 
                                                   add_numbers = T,
                                                   height = unit(4, "cm")),
                annotation_name_side = "left",
                annotation_name_rot = 90))
```

```{r UpsetPlotVisualzation_OverlapDEGenes_Advanced_8h_Fixed, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
### GENERATE DATA FRAMES NEEDED TO PLOT DATA ###
# Filter out the genes of interest in 2 different sets
UpsetData_COMB.Fixed <- c(lapply(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed, FUN = function(stim){(stim%>%
                                                                          filter(Annot == "UP"))[, "Gene"]}),
                       lapply(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed, FUN = function(stim){(stim%>%
                                                                          filter(Annot == "DOWN"))[, "Gene"]}))
names(UpsetData_COMB.Fixed)<- paste(names(UpsetData_COMB.Fixed), rep(c("UP", "DOWN"), each = 4), sep = "_")


# Generation of list of downregulated genes per 
UpsetData_COMB.Fixed <- as.data.frame(list_to_matrix(UpsetData_COMB.Fixed))

# Check if the expression change is consistent between stimulations
UpsetData_COMB.Fixed<-UpsetData_COMB.Fixed%>%
  mutate_at(vars(ends_with("UP")), function(x){ifelse(x==1, "UP", NA)})%>%
  mutate_at(vars(ends_with("DOWN")), function(x){ifelse(x==1, "DOWN", NA)})

# Check if the genes were upregulated/downregulated/mixed over the distinct subsets 
UpsetData_COMB.Fixed$Direction<-apply(UpsetData_COMB.Fixed, 1, function(col) {
  u <- unique(na.omit(col))
  if (length(u) == 1) {
    # either "UP" or "DOWN"
    return(u)
  } else if (length(u) > 1) {
    return("MIXED")
  } else {
    # no non-NA values
    return(NA_character_)
  }
})

# Store the genes linked to specific subsets
# stack function creates a data frame from a list
Subsets.Fixed<-stack(sapply(X = comb_name(UpsetData_SIGN.Fixed),
                      FUN = function(subset){extract_comb(UpsetData_SIGN.Fixed, subset)}))
colnames(Subsets.Fixed) <- c("Genes", "Subset")
UpsetData_COMB.Fixed <- left_join(x = UpsetData_COMB.Fixed%>%
                              rownames_to_column(var = "Genes"),
                            y = Subsets.Fixed,
                            by = "Genes")%>%
  mutate(Direction = factor(Direction, levels = c("MIXED", "UP", "DOWN"),
                               ordered = T))

# Store the table of the distinct directions
UpsetData_COMB.Fixed.table<-table(UpsetData_COMB.Fixed$Subset,
                                  UpsetData_COMB.Fixed$Direction)
```

Generation figure of the final upset plot

```{r PlotUpset_DEGenes_8h_Fixed, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
### PLOTTING THE DATA USING UPSET PLOT OF COMPLEX HEATMAP ###
# Generate upset plot
upPlot.Fixed<-
  UpSet(UpsetData_SIGN.Fixed, comb_order = order(comb_size(UpsetData_SIGN.Fixed), decreasing = T),
      #  Colors of the dots and balkjes onderaan 
      comb_col = "#595B5C", bg_pt_col = "white",
      # Add plot title
      column_title = "Overlap significant DE genes",
      # Update row annotation (entire set of DEgenes)
      right_annotation = rowAnnotation(
                "DE genes" = anno_barplot(set_size(UpsetData_SIGN.Fixed),
                                          border = FALSE,
                                          gp = gpar(fill = "#595B5C",
                                                    lty = "blank"), 
                                          add_numbers = T,
                                          width = unit(4, "cm"))),
      # Update column annotation on top of the Upset plot
      top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
                                      # Add barplot based on the direction of the DE genes
                "Intersection size" = anno_barplot(UpsetData_COMB.Fixed.table,
                                                   border = FALSE,
                                                   # Store correct colors
                                                   gp = gpar(fill = colDirection[colnames(
                                                     UpsetData_COMB.Fixed.table)],
                                                             lty = "blank"),
                                                   add_numbers = T,
                                                   height = unit(3, "cm")),
                # Annotation name shown at the left side
                annotation_name_side = "left",
                # Rotation of the annotation at the left side
                annotation_name_rot = 90))

# Generate legend
lgd = Legend(
  labels    = colnames(UpsetData_COMB.Fixed.table),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = colDirection[colnames(UpsetData_COMB.Fixed.table)]),
  title     = "Direction"
)

# Visualise the upset plot
# pdf(file.path(params$path_DEGenes, paste0(params$prefix_output, params$date2, "Upset_SignDEGenes_Stim_vs_Unstim_8h.pdf")), width=7, height=4)
draw(upPlot.Fixed,
     annotation_legend_list = list(lgd),
     annotation_legend_side = "left")
```

## Hypergeometric testing of gene sets enrichment

### `phyper` HGT testing

#### 8h stimulation

```{r Phyper_HGT_GOSets_8h_Fixed}
# Save the total number of genes in the entire dataset
totalGeneNumber<-length(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed$IFNgamma$Gene)

# Initialization of dataframa that will be filled in using the following code
GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=length(unique(GeneSets_GO_BP$gs_name)),ncol=1))
GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed$GeneSet <-unique(GeneSets_GO_BP$gs_name)
GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed<- GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed%>%column_to_rownames(var = "GeneSet")


# For-loop over the pathways of interest
for (pathway in GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed%>%rownames()){
  # Extract the genes of the pathway of interest
  pathway.genes<-(GeneSets_GO_BP%>%filter(gs_name == pathway))[['gene_symbol']]
  
  # For-loop over the distinct subsets
  for(stim in names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed)){
           # Initialization of names
           overlapUP.var<-paste("Overlap",stim, "UP", sep = "_")
           overlapUP.pval<-paste("pval", stim, "UP", sep = "_")
           overlapDOWN.var<-paste("Overlap",stim, "DOWN", sep = "_")
           overlapDOWN.pval<-paste("pval", stim, "DOWN", sep = "_")
           # Extract subset of interest
           subsetUP<-(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]%>%
             filter(Annot == "UP"))[["Gene"]]
           subsetDOWN<-(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]%>%
             filter(Annot == "DOWN"))[["Gene"]]
           # Check overlap + store in the final dataframe
           overlapUP<-length(intersect(pathway.genes, subsetUP))
           GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed[pathway, overlapUP.var]<-overlapUP
           overlapDOWN<-length(intersect(pathway.genes, subsetDOWN))
           GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed[pathway, overlapDOWN.var]<-overlapDOWN
           
           # Perform hypergeometric testing for upregulated genes
           GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed[pathway, overlapUP.pval]<-phyper(q = overlapUP - 1,
                                                       m = length(pathway.genes),
                                                       n = totalGeneNumber-length(pathway.genes),
                                                       k = length(subsetUP),
                                                       lower.tail = F)
           # Perform hypergeometric testing for downregulated genes
           GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed[pathway, overlapDOWN.pval]<-phyper(q = overlapDOWN - 1,
                                                       m = length(pathway.genes),
                                                       n = totalGeneNumber-length(pathway.genes),
                                                       k = length(subsetDOWN),
                                                       lower.tail = F)
           }
}

# Remove the unnecessary columns
GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed[["V1"]]<-NULL
```

```{r IncubTime_Phyper_HGT_MultipleTestingCorrection_GOSets_PerStim_Fixed}
# Multiple testing correction with Benjamini Hochberg
for(col in grep(pattern = "^pval", x = names(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed), value = T)){
  new_colname <- paste0('adj', col)
  GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed[,new_colname] <- p.adjust(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed[,col], method = "BH")
}

GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed%>%head()
```

```{r IncubTime_Phyper_HGT_Vis_Pval_Overview_Fixed, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}

       FUN = function(subset){
         sum(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed[[subset]]<=0.05)
       })
```

## Visualization of interesting genesets

### Heatmaps

```{r IncubTime_GSEA_PerStim_Heatmap_8h_Fixed, fig.height=20, fig.width=15}
# Extracting the most interesting gene sets based on the top 20 per subset
for (stim_dir in grep(pattern = "adjpval", x = names(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed), value = T)){
  top20GSE_stim <- head(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed%>%
                          # Only extract the top 10 of the upregulated genes
                       arrange(.data[[stim_dir]]), n = 10)%>%rownames
  
  # Store only the top 10 down/upregulated genes in a dataframe
  # First check if the dataframe is does exist or is empyt
  if (!exists("top20GSE_total.8h.Fixed") || length(top20GSE_total.8h.Fixed) == 0){
    message("Creating vector")
    top20GSE_total.8h.Fixed <- top20GSE_stim
  } else {
    message("\nJoining additional gene sets")
    # Adding additional genes if they are not yet present in the top20GSE list
   top20GSE_total.8h.Fixed <- unique(c(top20GSE_total.8h.Fixed, top20GSE_stim))
  }
}

# Extracting plot matrix necessary for heatmap generation
plotData.8h.Fixed <- (GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed[top20GSE_total.8h.Fixed,]%>%
  select(starts_with("adjpval"))%>%
  as.matrix()%>%
  log10())*(-1)
rownames(plotData.8h.Fixed)<-gsub(x = rownames(plotData.8h.Fixed), pattern = "GOBP_", replacement = "")

        row_names_rot = -45,
```

```{r DotPlot_GSEA_Visualization_8h_30h_HardCutOffs, fig.height=15, fig.width=15}
#### DOTPLOT ####
GSE_HGT_GO_BP.Combined.Fixed<-unique(c(top20GSE_total.8h.Fixed, top20GSE_total.30h.Fixed))

  full_join(

                 names_to = "Stimulation",
                 values_to = "AdjPval")%>%
    mutate(Stimulation = gsub(pattern = "adjpval_", replacement = "", Stimulation)),
  # Extract the overlap
  (GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed[GSE_HGT_GO_BP.Combined.Fixed,])%>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "GeneSet")%>%
    # Only select columns with adjusted Pvalue and overlap with gene set
    select("GeneSet", starts_with("Overlap"))%>%
    # Transform to longer format
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Overlap"),
                 names_to = "Stimulation",
                 values_to = "Overlap")%>%
    mutate(Stimulation = gsub(pattern = "Overlap_", replacement = "", Stimulation)),
  by = c('GeneSet', 'Stimulation'))%>%
    # Mark that these are the values for 8 hours of stimulation
    mutate(TimePoint = 8),
  
  # Extract data for 30h
  full_join(
  # Extract the adjusted pvalues
  (GSE_HGT_GO_BP.30h.Fixed[GSE_HGT_GO_BP.Combined.Fixed,])%>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "GeneSet")%>%
    # Only select columns with adjusted Pvalue and overlap with gene set
    select("GeneSet", starts_with("adjpval"))%>%
    # Transform to longer format
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("adjpval"),
                 names_to = "Stimulation",
                 values_to = "AdjPval")%>%
    mutate(Stimulation = gsub(pattern = "adjpval_", replacement = "", Stimulation)),
  # Extract the overlap
  (GSE_HGT_GO_BP.30h.Fixed[GSE_HGT_GO_BP.Combined.Fixed,])%>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "GeneSet")%>%
    # Only select columns with adjusted Pvalue and overlap with gene set
    select("GeneSet", starts_with("Overlap"))%>%
    # Transform to longer format
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Overlap"),
                 names_to = "Stimulation",
                 values_to = "Overlap")%>%
    mutate(Stimulation = gsub(pattern = "Overlap_", replacement = "", Stimulation)),
  by = c('GeneSet', 'Stimulation'))%>%
    # Mark that these are the values for 8 hours of stimulation
    mutate(TimePoint = 30)
  )%>%
  # Arrange the GSE names
  mutate(GeneSet = fct_reorder(GeneSet, -AdjPval),
         Stimulation = fct_reorder(Stimulation, -AdjPval),
        # Indicate in which timepoint this GSE was selected in top 20
         SelectIn = case_when(
           GeneSet %in% top20GSE_total.8h.Fixed & TimePoint == 8 ~ "8",
           GeneSet %in% top20GSE_total.30h.Fixed & TimePoint == 30 ~ "30",
           TRUE ~ NA
         ))%>%
  mutate(SelectIn = factor(SelectIn,
                            levels = c("8", "30"),
                            ordered = T))


# Plot data
(ggplot(data = dotPlot.Data.Fixed[!is.na(dotPlot.Data.Fixed$SelectIn),])+
   geom_tile(mapping = aes(x = SelectIn,

             na.rm = T, fill = "grey65")+

  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank()))+
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 6))+
```

## Differential gene expression analysis between time points

```{r DEGeneAnalysis_8hvs30h_Fixed}
set.seed(2024)

# Initialization of data frame
DEG_Stim_Unstim_8vs30_FilClus.Fixed<-sapply(unique(NBH_Selection_8h.Fixed.Cells$Stimulation),
                                            function(x) NULL)

# Perform DEG analysis
for (stim in names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8vs30_FilClus.Fixed)){
  # Select the cells inputted as stimulated cells: cells 8h first
  cells.1<-(NBH_Selection_8h.Fixed.Cells%>%
    filter(Condition == "Stimulated",
           Stimulation == stim))[, "CellID"]%>%
    # Unique names since the cells can be linked to multiple neighbourhoods
    unique()
  
  # Select the cells inputted as stimulated cells: cells 30h next
  cells.2<-(NBH_Selection_30h.Fixed.Cells%>%
    filter(Condition == "Stimulated",
           Stimulation == stim))[, "CellID"]%>%
    # Unique names since the cells can be linked to multiple neighbourhoods
    unique()
  
  #  Merge the 8h and 30h stimulated seuratobjects
  message(paste0("Working on stimulation ", stim))
  MergedSeurat_Stim<-merge(x = subset(IntData.B_8h.FilClus,
                                      cells = cells.1),
                           y = subset(IntData.B_30h.FilClus,
                                      cells = cells.2),
                           merge.data = TRUE,
                           merge.dr = TRUE)
  MergedSeurat_Stim[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(MergedSeurat_Stim[["RNA"]])
  Idents(MergedSeurat_Stim)<-"TimePoint"
  
  # Perform DEG analysis
  DEG_Stim_Unstim_8vs30_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]<-FindMarkers(object = MergedSeurat_Stim,
                                       min.pct = 0, logfc.threshold = 0,
                                       # 8h of stimulation as reference
                                       ident.1 = "30", 
                                       ident.2 = "8")%>%
    mutate(Score = (pct.1/(pct.2 + 0.01))*avg_log2FC)%>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "Gene")
}
# Cleaning workspace
rm(cells.1, cells.2, MergedSeurat_Stim)

# Save the data
saveRDS(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8vs30_FilClus.Fixed, 
        file = file.path(params$path_Results, 
                         "DEGAnalysis",
                         paste(params$date2, "DE_AllGenes_8vs30_PerStimulation_SelNhoods_HardCutOff3.5.rds", sep = "_")))
```

```{r DEGenesAnnot_Fixed}
  # Add additional information to the dataset
  DEG_Stim_Unstim_8vs30_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]<-DEG_Stim_Unstim_8vs30_FilClus.Fixed[[stim]]%>%
  mutate(Annot=case_when(
```

```{r Phyper_HGT_GOSets_8hvs30h_Fixed}
           # Perform hypergeometric testing for downregulated genes
           GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8hvs30h.Fixed[pathway, overlapDOWN.pval]<-phyper(q = overlapDOWN - 1,
                                                       m = length(pathway.genes),
                                                       n = totalGeneNumber-length(pathway.genes),
                                                       k = length(subsetDOWN),
                                                       lower.tail = F)
           }
}

# Remove the unnecessary columns
GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8hvs30h.Fixed[["V1"]]<-NULL
```

```{r IncubTime_Phyper_HGT_MultipleTestingCorrection_GOSets_PerStim_Fixed}
# Multiple testing correction with Benjamini Hochberg
for(col in grep(pattern = "^pval", x = names(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8hvs30h.Fixed), value = T)){
  new_colname <- paste0('adj', col)
  GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8hvs30h.Fixed[,new_colname] <- p.adjust(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8hvs30h.Fixed[,col], method = "BH")
}

GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8hvs30h.Fixed%>%head()
```

```{r DotPlot_GSEA_Visualization_8h_30h_HardCutOffs, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
# Extracting the most interesting gene sets based on the top 20 per subset
for (stim_dir in grep(pattern = "adjpval", x = names(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8hvs30h.Fixed), value = T)){
  top20GSE_stim <- head(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8hvs30h.Fixed%>%
                          # Only extract the top 10 of the upregulated genes
                       arrange(.data[[stim_dir]]), n = 10)%>%rownames
  
  # Store only the top 10 down/upregulated genes in a dataframe
  # First check if the dataframe is does exist or is empyt
  if (!exists("top20GSE_total.8hvs30h.Fixed") || length(top20GSE_total.8hvs30h.Fixed) == 0){
    message("Creating vector")
    top20GSE_total.8hvs30h.Fixed <- top20GSE_stim
  } else {
    message("\nJoining additional gene sets")
    # Adding additional genes if they are not yet present in the top20GSE list
   top20GSE_total.8hvs30h.Fixed <- unique(c(top20GSE_total.8hvs30h.Fixed, top20GSE_stim))
  }
}

#### DOTPLOT ####
# Prepare data
dotPlot_8hvs30h.Data.Fixed<-  full_join(
  # Extract the adjusted pvalues
  (GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8hvs30h.Fixed[top20GSE_total.8hvs30h.Fixed,])%>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "GeneSet")%>%
    # Only select columns with adjusted Pvalue and overlap with gene set
    select("GeneSet", starts_with("adjpval"))%>%
    # Transform to longer format
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("adjpval"),
                 names_to = "Stimulation",
                 values_to = "AdjPval")%>%
    mutate(Stimulation = gsub(pattern = "adjpval_", replacement = "", Stimulation)),
  # Extract the overlap
  (GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8hvs30h.Fixed[top20GSE_total.8hvs30h.Fixed,]%>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "GeneSet")%>%
    # Only select columns with adjusted Pvalue and overlap with gene set
    select("GeneSet", starts_with("Overlap"))%>%
    # Transform to longer format
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Overlap"),
                 names_to = "Stimulation",
                 values_to = "Overlap")%>%
    mutate(Stimulation = gsub(pattern = "Overlap_", replacement = "", Stimulation))),
  by = c('GeneSet', 'Stimulation'))%>%
  # Arrange the GSE names
  mutate(GeneSet = fct_reorder(GeneSet, -AdjPval),
         Stimulation = factor(Stimulation,
                             levels = c("ODN2006_UP", "IFNgamma_UP", "MegaCD40L_UP", "antiCD3CD28_UP",
                                        "ODN2006_DOWN", "IFNgamma_DOWN", "MegaCD40L_DOWN", "antiCD3CD28_DOWN"),
                             order = T))


# Plot data
ggplot(data = dotPlot_8hvs30h.Data.Fixed)+
  geom_vline(mapping = aes(xintercept = Stimulation),

             alpha = 0.5)+

             color = "grey80", 
             alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = Stimulation,
                     y = GeneSet,
                     size = Overlap,
                     fill  = -log10(AdjPval)),
             shape = 21, color = "grey50")+
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("white", "lightblue", "darkblue", "#04074E"),
                        breaks = c(0, 40, 70),
                        values = c(0, 0.05, 0.50, 0.95, 1))+
  scale_size(range = c(0,6))+
  themeG+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   vjust = 1, hjust = 0), 
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank())+
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top")+
  ggtitle("Hard Cutoffs for Nhood selection")
```

## Differential gene expression analysis - unstimulated vs stimulated

```{r DEGeneAnalysis_8h_Fixed_Meta}
set.seed(2024)

# Initialization of data frame
DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta<-sapply(unique(NBH_Selection_8h.Fixed.Cells$Stimulation),
                                              function(x) NULL)

# Perform DEG analysis
for (stim in names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta)){
  # Select the cells inputted as stimulated cells, cells.2 in FindMarkers() function
  cells.1<-(NBH_Selection_8h.Fixed.Cells%>%
    filter(Condition == "Stimulated",
           Stimulation == stim))[, "CellID"]%>%
    # Unique names since the cells can be linked to multiple neighbourhoods
    unique()
  
  # Only select cells that also overlap with the correct metadata annotation for the stimulation
  if (stim == "antiCD3CD28"){
    # Solve problem with naming
    cells.1<-cells.1[IntData.B_8h.FilClus$Stimulation[cells.1] %in% "CD3/CD28_beads"]
    } else {
      cells.1<-cells.1[IntData.B_8h.FilClus$Stimulation[cells.1] %in% stim]
      }
  
  # Add the annotation as a metadata column to used in the FindMarkers() function
  CellAnnot_Stim.tmp<-rep(x = "Skip", times = dim(IntData.B_8h.FilClus)[2])
  names(CellAnnot_Stim.tmp)<-colnames(IntData.B_8h.FilClus)
  CellAnnot_Stim.tmp[cells.1]<-stim
  CellAnnot_Stim.tmp[NBH_Selection_Unstim_8h.Fixed.Cells]<-"Unstimulated"
  IntData.B_8h.FilClus$SelCells_DEGAnalyisis<-CellAnnot_Stim.tmp
  
  # Printing some information on the cells that were used for the analysis
  message("For condition ", stim, " a total of ", length(cells.1), " was inputted for DEG analysis.")
  print(table(IntData.B_8h.FilClus$SelCells_DEGAnalyisis, IntData.B_8h.FilClus$Stimulation))
  
  Idents(IntData.B_8h.FilClus)<-"SelCells_DEGAnalyisis"
  
  # Perform DEG analysis
  DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]<-FindMarkers(object = IntData.B_8h.FilClus,
                                       min.pct = 0, logfc.threshold = 0,
                                       ident.1 = stim, 
                                       ident.2 = "Unstimulated")%>%
    mutate(Score = (pct.1/(pct.2 + 0.01))*avg_log2FC)%>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "Gene")
}
# Cleaning workspace
rm(cells.1, CellAnnot_Stim.tmp)
IntData.B_8h.FilClus$SelCells_DEGAnalyisis<-NULL

# Save the data
saveRDS(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta, 
        file = file.path(params$path_Results, 
                         "DEGAnalysis",
                         paste(params$date4, "DE_AllGenes_8h_PerStimulation_SelNhoods_HardCutOff3_StimMetaData.rds", sep = "_")))
```

## Revision of annotation of the cells - Original approach

### Fraction of unstimulated cells

To check the original samples of which the truly unstimulated cells originate from, a comparison is made and a visualization is also generated. This means that cells that were annotated based on Nhoods as unstimulated could also originate from samples that were stimulated with an in vitro stimulatory reagent. However, these cells are reannotated as unstimulated because they are in the end more similar to the unstimulated condition.

```{r OriginUnstimulatedCells_PlotData}
# Extract the number of cells that are retained as unstimulated
# Take into account their real origin linked to condition and donor
PlotUnstimOrigin<-rbind(
  data.frame(table(IntData.B_8h.FilClus$Stimulation[NBH_Selection_Unstim_8h.Fixed.Cells],
                   IntData.B_8h.FilClus$PatientID[NBH_Selection_Unstim_8h.Fixed.Cells]),
             TimePoint = 8),
  data.frame(table(IntData.B_30h.FilClus$Stimulation[NBH_Selection_Unstim_30h.Fixed.Cells],
                   IntData.B_30h.FilClus$PatientID[NBH_Selection_Unstim_30h.Fixed.Cells]),
             TimePoint = 30))
# Clean up the names of the dataset
names(PlotUnstimOrigin)[1:3]<-c("Condition", "Donor", "NumberCells")

# Total number of cells
TotalUnstim<-rbind(
  data.frame(table(IntData.B_8h.FilClus$PatientID[NBH_Selection_Unstim_8h.Fixed.Cells]),
             TimePoint = 8),
  data.frame(table(IntData.B_30h.FilClus$PatientID[NBH_Selection_Unstim_30h.Fixed.Cells]),
             TimePoint = 30))
# Clean up the names of the dataset
names(TotalUnstim)[1:2]<-c("Donor", "TotalCells")

# Add the total number of cells per combination
PlotUnstimOrigin<-full_join(PlotUnstimOrigin,
                            TotalUnstim,
                            by = c("Donor", "TimePoint"))
# Calculate proportions
PlotUnstimOrigin<-PlotUnstimOrigin%>%
  mutate(Fraction = NumberCells/TotalCells)
# Clean workspace
rm(TotalUnstim)
```

```{r OriginUnstimulatedCells_Graph, fig.width=3, fig.height=2}
# Fractions per donor
ggplot(PlotUnstimOrigin,
       mapping = aes(x = Donor,
                     y = Fraction,
                     fill = Condition))+
  geom_col()+
  facet_grid(.~TimePoint)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = colorsStim)+
  theme_bar+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
  labs(title = "Origin of unstimulated cells",
       subtitle = "Unstimulated cells selected based on the seleceted Nhoods")

# Fractions without taking into account the donors
ggplot(data = PlotUnstimOrigin%>%group_by(TimePoint, Condition)%>%
         summarise(SumFrac = sum(Fraction)/4)%>%
         mutate(TimePoint = factor(TimePoint,
                                   levels = c(8, 30),
                                   order = T)),
       mapping = aes(x = TimePoint,
                     y = SumFrac,
                     fill = Condition))+
  geom_col()+
  scale_fill_manual(values = colorsStim)+
  themeG+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")+
  labs(title = "Origin of unstimulated cells",
       subtitle = "Unstimulated cells selected based on the seleceted Nhoods")+
  coord_flip()
```

### Fraction stimulated cells

In this section, a comparing of the number of cells that were annotated as stimulated as a fraction of the original input of cells is made. For this, a grouping is performed to look at the differences per combination of donor and stimulation.

```{r SelectionCells_Composition}
#### 8 hours ####
## Prepare the data to plot
# Extract cell IDs per stimulation
Cells_Selection_8h_Stim.Fixed.Meta<-lapply(X = unique(NBH_Selection_8h.Fixed.Cells$Stimulation),
                                           FUN = function(stim){
                                             # Save cells linked to the selected NBHs
                                             cells<-(NBH_Selection_8h.Fixed.Cells%>%
                                                      filter(Condition == "Stimulated",
                                                             Stimulation == stim))[, "CellID"]%>%
                                                      # Unique names since the cells can be linked to multiple neighbourhoods
                                                      unique()
                                             # Only select cells that also overlap with the correct metadata annotation for the stimulation
                                            if (stim == "antiCD3CD28"){
                                              # Solve problem with naming
                                              cells<-cells[IntData.B_8h.FilClus$Stimulation[cells] %in% "CD3/CD28_beads"]
                                              } else {
                                                cells<-cells[IntData.B_8h.FilClus$Stimulation[cells] %in% stim]
                                              }
                                             # Store in dataframe and link to specific HC 
                                             df.tmp<-data.frame(Cells = cells)%>%
                                               mutate(HC = IntData.B_8h.FilClus$PatientID[Cells],
                                                      Stimulation = stim)
                                             return(df.tmp)
                                           })

# Calculate number of cells linked to stimulation and HC

  group_by(Stimulation, HC)%>%
  summarise(StimulatedCells=n())
```

It should be noted that we can take into account the unstimulated cells as well to have a reference of stimulation of the cells in condition in which no stimulation is added, the so called "standard stimulation of the PBMCs".

```{r SelectionCells_Composition_UnstimRef}
#### 8 hours ####

                                           FUN = function(stim){
                                             # Save cells linked to the selected NBHs

                                                      filter(Condition == "Stimulated",
                                                             Stimulation == stim))[, "CellID"]%>%
                                                      # Unique names since the cells can be linked to multiple neighbourhoods
                                                      unique()
                                             # Only select cells that also overlap with the correct metadata, in this case the unstimulated condition

                                             return(df.tmp)

  group_by(Stimulation, HC)%>%
```

### Statistical testing of the differences
The differences in fraction of truly stimulated cells after 8h and 30h is performed by using a paired t-test due to following reasons:
- 2 dependent variables (1 sample measured twice)
- Normal distribution of the data (fractions are expected to be normally distributed around the mean)

```{r StatisticalTesting_TrueStimulations}
Cells_Selection_Stim.Fixed.Meta  %>%
  group_by(Stimulation)%>%
  t_test(FracStim~TimePoint, paired=FALSE,
         conf.level = 0.99) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>% 
  add_xy_position(x = "Stimulation")
```

## Revision of annotation of the cells - Updated approach

### Fraction calculation and visualization

```{r RevisedAnnotation_DFInitialization}
# Extract all the cells for both incubation time points
UpdAnnot_Cells_Stim_Unstim<-data.frame(CellID = c(colnames(IntData.B_8h.FilClus),
                                           colnames(IntData.B_30h.FilClus)),
                                # Add correct time point to cells
                                TimePoint = rep(c("8h", "30h"),
                                                times = c(dim(IntData.B_8h.FilClus)[2],
                                                          dim(IntData.B_30h.FilClus)[2])))%>%
  #### METADATA BASED ####
  # Extract the original annotation based on the metadata of the cells in the Seurat object
  mutate(MetaD_Annot = case_when(
      TimePoint == "8h" ~ IntData.B_8h.FilClus$Stimulation[CellID]%>%unname(),
      TimePoint == "30h" ~ IntData.B_30h.FilClus$Stimulation[CellID]%>%unname()))%>%
  # Make sure naming of the conditions is consistent
  mutate(MetaD_Annot = gsub(pattern = "CD3/CD28_beads",
                            replacement = "antiCD3CD28",
                            x = MetaD_Annot))%>%
  #### HEALTHY DONOR INFORMATION ####
  mutate(HC = case_when(
      TimePoint == "8h" ~ IntData.B_8h.FilClus$PatientID[CellID]%>%unname(),
      TimePoint == "30h" ~ IntData.B_30h.FilClus$PatientID[CellID]%>%unname()))%>%
  
  #### NBH BASED ####
  # Unstimulated cells based on NBHs
  mutate(NBH_Annot = case_when(
    TimePoint == "8h" & CellID %in% NBH_Selection_Unstim_8h.Fixed.Cells ~ "Unstimulated",
    TimePoint == "30h" & CellID %in% NBH_Selection_Unstim_30h.Fixed.Cells ~ "Unstimulated",
    # Cells that are skipped (for now and for the downstream additional annotation step)
    TRUE ~ "Undefined"
  ))%>%
  # Stimulated cells
  left_join(y = rbind(NBH_Selection_8h.Fixed.Cells,
                      NBH_Selection_30h.Fixed.Cells),
            by = "CellID")%>%
  mutate(NBH_Annot = case_when(
    # If consensus in NBH-based annotation and metadata (if not unstimulated)
    NBH_Annot != "Unstimulated" & MetaD_Annot == Stimulation ~ MetaD_Annot,
    # Otherwise keep the original annotation
    TRUE ~ NBH_Annot))%>%
  select(CellID, TimePoint, MetaD_Annot, NBH_Annot, HC)%>%
  
  #### FACTORIZATION OF COLUMNS ####
  mutate(TimePoint = factor(TimePoint,
                            levels = c("8h", "30h"),
                            ordered = T),
         MetaD_Annot = factor(MetaD_Annot,
                              levels = c("ODN2006", "IFNgamma", "MegaCD40L", "antiCD3CD28", "Unstimulated"),
                              ordered = T),
         NBH_Annot = factor(NBH_Annot,
                            levels = c("ODN2006", "IFNgamma", "MegaCD40L", "antiCD3CD28", "Unstimulated", "Undefined"),
                            ordered = T))

# Still a lot of duplicated cells present due to the fact that one cell can be linked to multiple neighbourhoods
dim(UpdAnnot_Cells_Stim_Unstim)

# Filtering out the duplicates
# The original an new annotation will be the same for all the duplicates so it does not matter which duplicate is removed
UpdAnnot_Cells_Stim_Unstim<-UpdAnnot_Cells_Stim_Unstim%>%
  # Ordering needed to avoid that "Undefined" labels overrule the real final stimulation label
  arrange(NBH_Annot)%>%
  # Label the duplicates
  mutate(Dupl = duplicated(CellID))%>%
  # Filter out the duplicates
  filter(!Dupl)%>%
  # Remove unnecessary columns
  select(-Dupl)
# Check the 
dim(UpdAnnot_Cells_Stim_Unstim)

message("Original annotation based on metadata")
table(UpdAnnot_Cells_Stim_Unstim$MetaD_Annot,
      UpdAnnot_Cells_Stim_Unstim$TimePoint)
message("Original annotation based on NBH selection")
table(UpdAnnot_Cells_Stim_Unstim$NBH_Annot,
      UpdAnnot_Cells_Stim_Unstim$TimePoint)
```

### Statistical testing of differences

#### T-test and Wilcoxon test

```{r StatTest_StimFrac}
#### T-TEST ####
UpdAnnot_Cells_Stim_Unstim.Fractions  %>%
  group_by(NBH_Annot, MetaD_Annot)%>%
  t_test(Frac_MetaD~TimePoint, paired=TRUE,
         conf.level = 0.95) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH", output.col = "p.adj_BH")%>%
  add_significance(p.col = "p.adj_BH",
                   output.col = "p.adj.signif_BH")

#### WILCOXON TEST ####
UpdAnnot_Cells_Stim_Unstim.Fractions  %>%
  group_by(NBH_Annot, MetaD_Annot)%>%
  wilcox_test(Frac_MetaD~TimePoint, 
              p.adjust.method = "none", 
              paired = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH", output.col = "p.adj_BH")%>%
  add_significance(p.col = "p.adj_BH",
                   output.col = "p.adj.signif_BH")
```

#### GLMM testing

#### Set up the model

```{r GLMM_SetUp}
# Generate model
BModel_RevAnnot <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(Frac_MetaD ~ NBH_Annot*MetaD_Annot + HC + TimePoint*MetaD_Annot,
                                    data = UpdAnnot_Cells_Stim_Unstim.Fractions%>%
                                      # None of the factors should be ordered!
                                      mutate(NBH_Annot = factor(NBH_Annot,
                                                  levels = c("Unstimulated", "Undefined",  "ODN2006",
                                                              "IFNgamma", "MegaCD40L", "antiCD3CD28"),
                                                   labels = c("Unstimulated","Undefined", "Stimulated",
                                                              "Stimulated", "Stimulated", "Stimulated" )),
                                             MetaD_Annot = factor(MetaD_Annot,
                                                                  levels = c("Unstimulated", "ODN2006",
                                                                             "IFNgamma",
                                                                             "MegaCD40L", "antiCD3CD28")),
                                              TimePoint = factor(TimePoint,
                                                   levels = c("8h", "30h")),
                                              Frac_MetaD = Frac_MetaD/100),
                                    family = glmmTMB::beta_family(link = "logit"),
                                    # Beta distribution separately calculated for each of the stimulatory 
                                    # conditions separately
                                    dispformula = ~MetaD_Annot)

# Check model# Check model# Check model
BModel_RevAnnot

# Check QC of model 
# Conform linear regression with QQ-plot
simres <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(BModel_RevAnnot)
plot(simres)
# Clean
rm(simres)
```

Predictions look good, showing that this is a good model to use :)

##### Contrasts

First, write function to extract correct contrasts.

```{r GenerationOfContrasts}
contraster <- function(obj = BModel_RevAnnot, 
                       MetaD_Annot = "ODN2006", 
                       NBH_Annot = "Stimulated", 
                       Time = "8h",
                       Ref_NBH_Annot = "Unstimulated",
                       Ref_Time = "8h") {
  # Store coefficients of model
  coefs <- coef(summary(obj))$cond %>% rownames
  # Define reference
  ref_NBH_Annot <- paste0('NBH_Annot', Ref_NBH_Annot)
  # Define condition of interest
  test_NBH_Annot <- paste0('NBH_Annot', NBH_Annot)
  # Define reference
  ref_MetaD_Annot <- paste0('MetaD_Annot', MetaD_Annot)
  # Define condition of interest
  test_MetaD_Annot <- paste0('MetaD_Annot', MetaD_Annot)
  # Define reference
  ref_Time <- paste0('TimePoint', Ref_Time)
  # Define condition of interest
  test_Time <- paste0('TimePoint', Time)
  # Select references
  ref <- case_when(
    # Select the interactions of interest
    str_detect(coefs, ':') ~ str_detect(coefs, ref_NBH_Annot)*str_detect(coefs, ref_MetaD_Annot) + 
      str_detect(coefs, ref_Time) * str_detect(coefs, ref_MetaD_Annot),
    # Select additive effects of interest
    !str_detect(coefs, ':') ~ str_detect(coefs, ref_NBH_Annot) + str_detect(coefs, ref_MetaD_Annot) + 
      str_detect(coefs, ref_Time))
  
  test <- case_when(
    # Select the interactions of interest 
    str_detect(coefs, ':') ~ str_detect(coefs, test_NBH_Annot)*str_detect(coefs, test_MetaD_Annot) + 
      str_detect(coefs, test_Time) * str_detect(coefs, test_MetaD_Annot),
    # Select the additive effects of interest
    !str_detect(coefs, ':') ~ str_detect(coefs, test_NBH_Annot)+str_detect(coefs, test_MetaD_Annot) + 
      str_detect(coefs, test_Time))
  # Extract the coefficeints
  out <- as.matrix(test - ref)
  colnames(out) <- sprintf("%s vs. %s for %s at %s (ref. %s)", 
                           NBH_Annot, Ref_NBH_Annot, MetaD_Annot, Ref_Time, Time)
  # rownames(out) <- coefs
  return(t(out))
}
```

```{r ContrastMatrix}
# Initialization
ContrastMat_8h<-NULL
ContrastMat_30h<-NULL
ContrastMat_TimePoint<-NULL

# Store the correct naming of the stimulations
NBH_Annot.vec<-c("Unstimulated", "Stimulated", "Undefined")
MetaD_Annot.vec<-c("Unstimulated","ODN2006", "IFNgamma", "MegaCD40L", "antiCD3CD28")

#### 8 HOURS ####
# Contrast generation for 8h
for (stim in MetaD_Annot.vec){
  for (i in 1:(length(NBH_Annot.vec)-1)){
    for (j in (i+1):length(NBH_Annot.vec)){
      # Report what has been tested
        message(sprintf("Test %s vs. %s in %s at 8h", NBH_Annot.vec[j], NBH_Annot.vec[i], stim))
      # Extract and save the contrast matrix
      ContrastMat_8h <- rbind(ContrastMat_8h,
                              contraster(obj = BModel_RevAnnot,
                                         MetaD_Annot = stim,
                                         NBH_Annot = NBH_Annot.vec[j],
                                         Ref_NBH_Annot = NBH_Annot.vec[i],
                                         Time = "8h", 
                                         Ref_Time = "8h"))
    }
  }
}

# Add the coefficients as colnames
colnames(ContrastMat_8h) <- coef(summary(BModel_RevAnnot))$cond %>% rownames

#### 30 HOURS ####
# Contrast generation for 30h
for (stim in MetaD_Annot.vec){
  for (i in 1:(length(NBH_Annot.vec)-1)){
    for (j in (i+1):length(NBH_Annot.vec)){
      # Report what has been tested
        message(sprintf("Test %s vs. %s in %s at 30h", NBH_Annot.vec[j], NBH_Annot.vec[i], stim))
      # Extract and save the contrast matrix
      ContrastMat_30h <- rbind(ContrastMat_30h,
                              contraster(obj = BModel_RevAnnot,
                                         MetaD_Annot = stim,
                                         NBH_Annot = NBH_Annot.vec[j],
                                         Ref_NBH_Annot = NBH_Annot.vec[i],
                                         Time = "30h", 
                                         Ref_Time = "30h"))
    }
  }
}

# Add the coefficients as colnames
colnames(ContrastMat_30h) <- coef(summary(BModel_RevAnnot))$cond %>% rownames

#### BETWEEN TIMEPOINTS ####
# Contrast generation for 30h
for (stim in MetaD_Annot.vec){
  for (i in 1:(length(NBH_Annot.vec))){
      # Report what has been tested
      message(sprintf("Test %s in %s for 8h vs. 30h", NBH_Annot.vec[i], stim))
      # Extract and save the contrast matrix
      ContrastMat_TimePoint <- rbind(ContrastMat_TimePoint,
                              contraster(obj = BModel_RevAnnot,
                                         MetaD_Annot = stim,
                                         NBH_Annot = NBH_Annot.vec[i],
                                         Ref_NBH_Annot = NBH_Annot.vec[i],
                                         Time = "30h", 
                                         Ref_Time = "8h"))
  }
}

# Add the coefficients as colnames
colnames(ContrastMat_TimePoint) <- coef(summary(BModel_RevAnnot))$cond %>% rownames
```

```{r Testing_8h}
ResTest_8h <- left_join(
    multcomp::glht(model = BModel_RevAnnot, linfct = ContrastMat_8h) %>% 
      # Extract the p values and statistics
      summary %>% tidy,
    multcomp::glht(BModel_RevAnnot, linfct = ContrastMat_8h) %>% 
      # Extract confidence interval
      confint %>% tidy
  ) %>%
    # Backtransformation (logit family used in modelling) to obtain fractions again
    mutate(`Odds Ratio` = exp(estimate),
           `95% CI, lower` = exp(conf.low),
           `95% CI, upper` = exp(conf.high),
           `Statistic` = statistic,
           `Adj. p-value` = ifelse(adj.p.value < 0.001, 
                                "<0.001", 
                                round(adj.p.value, 3))%>% as.character) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric)) %>% round(., 2)) %>%
    add_significance(p.col = "adj.p.value", output.col = "Significance")%>%
    dplyr::select(Contrast = contrast,
           `Odds Ratio`,
           `95% CI, lower`,
           `95% CI, upper`,
           `Statistic`,
           `Adj. p-value`,
           `Adj.p_orig` = adj.p.value,
           Significance)

knitr::kable(ResTest_8h) %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_styling()
```

## Annotation of the DEgenes for downstream analysis

```{r DEGenesAnnot_Fixed_Meta}
# Average log2FC that should be used for filtering of interesting genes
log2FC_thres <- 2
adjpval_thres <- 0.05

# Annotation of the genes
for (stim in names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta)){
  # Add additional information to the dataset
  DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]<-DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]%>%
  mutate(Annot=case_when(
    avg_log2FC > log2FC_thres & p_val_adj < adjpval_thres ~ "UP",
    avg_log2FC < -log2FC_thres & p_val_adj < adjpval_thres ~ "DOWN",
    TRUE ~ "NS"))
  # Select genes to be plotted as label on the volcano graph
  top20genes <- head(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]%>%
                       filter(Annot != 'NS')%>%
                       arrange(p_val_adj, descending = TRUE), 20)[,'Gene']
  DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]<-DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]%>%
    mutate(GeneLabels=ifelse(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]$Gene %in% top20genes,
                             DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]$Gene,NA))
}

for (stim in names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta)){
  # Add additional information to the dataset
  DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]<-DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]%>%
  mutate(Annot=case_when(
    avg_log2FC > log2FC_thres & p_val_adj < adjpval_thres ~ "UP",
    avg_log2FC < -log2FC_thres & p_val_adj < adjpval_thres ~ "DOWN",
    TRUE ~ "NS"))
  # Select genes to be plotted as label on the volcano graph
  top20genes <- head(DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]%>%
                       filter(Annot != 'NS')%>%
                       arrange(p_val_adj, descending = TRUE), 20)[,'Gene']
  DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]<-DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]%>%
    mutate(GeneLabels=ifelse(DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]$Gene %in% top20genes,
                             DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]$Gene,NA))
}
rm(top20genes)
```
