## Visualization of DEGenes per stimulation

### Top regulated genes - Dotplots - Overall

```{r ExtractTop20Genes_HardCutoff, fig.width=4, fig.height=10}
top = 5
#### Extract top 10 genes up- and down separately ####
topGenes_8h.Fixed.Meta <- lapply(X = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta),
                        FUN = function(stim){rbind(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]%>%
                                                      filter(Annot == "DOWN")%>%
                                                      arrange(Score)%>%
                                                      head(n = top)%>%
                                                      mutate(Stimulation = stim)%>%
                                                      dplyr::select(Gene, Stimulation),
                                                     DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]%>%
                                                      filter(Annot == "UP")%>%
                                                      arrange(-Score)%>%
                                                      head(n = top)%>%
                                                      mutate(Stimulation = stim)%>%
                                                      dplyr::select(Gene, Stimulation))})
# Place in 1 dataframe
topGenes_8h.Fixed.Meta <- do.call("rbind", topGenes_8h.Fixed.Meta)%>%
  mutate(InTop = TRUE,
         TimePoint = 8)

# Extract top 10 genes up- and down seperately
topGenes_30h.Fixed.Meta <- lapply(X = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta),
                        FUN = function(stim){rbind(DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]%>%
                                                      filter(Annot == "DOWN")%>%
                                                      arrange(Score)%>%
                                                      head(n = top)%>%
                                                      mutate(Stimulation = stim)%>%
                                                      dplyr::select(Gene, Stimulation),
                                                     DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]%>%
                                                      filter(Annot == "UP")%>%
                                                      arrange(-Score)%>%
                                                      head(n = top)%>%
                                                      mutate(Stimulation = stim)%>%
                                                      dplyr::select(Gene, Stimulation))})
# Place in 1 dataframe
topGenes_30h.Fixed.Meta <- do.call("rbind", topGenes_30h.Fixed.Meta)%>%
  mutate(InTop = TRUE,
         TimePoint = 30)

topGenes_8h_30h.Fixed.Meta<-rbind(topGenes_8h.Fixed.Meta,
                               topGenes_30h.Fixed.Meta)

#### Extract data for these genes for each of the stimulations ####
topGenes_8h.Data.Fixed.Meta <- lapply(X = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta),
                            FUN = function(stim){DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]%>%
                                # Only select the genes of interest as obtained above
                                filter(Gene %in% unique(topGenes_8h_30h.Fixed.Meta$Gene))%>%
                                # Only select columns of interest for visualization
                                dplyr::select(Gene, avg_log2FC, Score)%>%
                                # Add metadata column to retain the original stimulation
                                mutate(Stimulation = stim)})%>%
  # Paste dataframes stored in list
  do.call(what = "rbind")%>%
  # Indicate if in top in specific stimulation
  left_join(y = topGenes_8h.Fixed.Meta,
            by = join_by(Gene, Stimulation))%>%
```

##### NCBI information scraping

To link information to the gene of interest based on the NCBI database, a data scraping step is performed using the `rentrez` R package. The following links contain necessary examples, vignettes and explanation on how this is properly performed

- https://bioconnector.github.io/workshops/r-ncbi.html

```{r FunctionExtractData_Entrez}
for (gene in topGenes_8h_30h.Data.Fixed.Meta$Gene%>%
                 levels()%>%
                 sort()){
  # Get the gene ids based on the NCBI database
  gene_ids<-entrez_search(db = "gene", term  = paste0(gene, "[Gene] AND Homo Sapiens[Organism]"))
  # Fetch the necessary data based on the extracted gene_ids
  for (ids in gene_ids$ids){
    # Stored as docsum
    gene_info.docsum<-entrez_fetch(db = "gene", id = ids, rettype = "docsum")
    # Get the data in an interesting format
    gene_info.df<-data.frame(OGInfo=strsplit(x = gene_info.docsum, split = '\n')|>
      unlist())|>
      filter(grepl(OGInfo, pattern = paste(c("<Name>", "<Description>", "<Summary>"), collapse = "|")))|>
      # Remove the tabs
      mutate(OGInfo = gsub(pattern = "\t", replacement = "", x = OGInfo))|>
      mutate(Gene = gene,
             Key = lapply(X = OGInfo, FUN = function(x){strsplit(x = x, split = "<|>|</")[[1]][2]})%>%
               unlist(),
             Value = lapply(X = OGInfo, FUN = function(x){strsplit(x = x, split = "<|>|</")[[1]][3]})%>%
               unlist())|>
      dplyr::select(-OGInfo)|>
      pivot_wider(names_from = Key,
                  values_from = Value)
    
    # Concatenate all the information on the genes of interest
    if (gene_info.df$Summary=="") {
      # If no additional information is added, the data is not concatenated to the dataframe
      break
      } else if (!exists("topGenes_8h_30h.Data.Fixed.Meta.info") || (dim(topGenes_8h_30h.Data.Fixed.Meta.info)[1]) == 0){
      message("Creating dataframe")
      topGenes_8h_30h.Data.Fixed.Meta.info <- gene_info.df
      } else {
      message("\nJoining dataframes")
      # Using full_join to add the other genes that were found in other stimulations
      topGenes_8h_30h.Data.Fixed.Meta.info <- rbind(topGenes_8h_30h.Data.Fixed.Meta.info,
                                                y = gene_info.df)
    }
  }
}

rm(gene_ids, gene_info.df)

# Saving the final dataset
write.xlsx(topGenes_8h_30h.Data.Fixed.Meta.info, file.path(params$path_Results, "DEGAnalysis", paste0(params$date4, 
                                                        "_Info_Top10DEGenes_SelNBH_Meta_8hand30h.xlsx")))
```

### Upset plot

This visualization strategy is similar to what is performed in script `011_DEGenes_Visulaization_GSEAOverlap.Rmd`, to check the overlap in differentially expressed genes between stimulatory conditions.

#### 8h stimulation

```{r UpsetPlotVisualzation_OverlapDEGenes_8h_Fixed_Meta, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
# Only focus on significantly different genes
UpsetData_SIGN_8h.Fixed.Meta <- list("IFNgamma" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta$IFNgamma%>%
                                 filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"], 
                     "MegaCD40L" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta$MegaCD40L%>%
                                      filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"], 
                     "ODN2006" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta$ODN2006%>%
                                    filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"],
                     "CD3CD28" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta$antiCD3CD28%>%
                                    filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"]) 
# Generation of list of downregulated genes per 
UpsetData_SIGN_8h.Fixed.Meta <- list_to_matrix(UpsetData_SIGN_8h.Fixed.Meta)
# Generation of comb_mat object
UpsetData_SIGN_8h.Fixed.Meta <- make_comb_mat(UpsetData_SIGN_8h.Fixed.Meta, mode = "distinct")
# Generation of the plot
UpSet(UpsetData_SIGN_8h.Fixed.Meta, comb_order = order(comb_size(UpsetData_SIGN_8h.Fixed.Meta), decreasing = T),
      comb_col = "#595B5C", bg_pt_col = "white",
      column_title = "Overlap significant DE genes",
      right_annotation = rowAnnotation(
                "DE genes" = anno_barplot(set_size(UpsetData_SIGN_8h.Fixed.Meta),
                                          border = FALSE,
                                          gp = gpar(fill = "#595B5C",
                                                    lty = "blank"), 
                                          add_numbers = T,
                                          width = unit(4, "cm"))),
      top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
                "Intersection size" = anno_barplot(comb_size(UpsetData_SIGN_8h.Fixed.Meta),
                                                   border = FALSE,
                                                   gp = gpar(fill = "#595B5C",
                                                             lty = "blank"), 
                                                   add_numbers = T,
                                                   height = unit(4, "cm")),
                annotation_name_side = "left",
                annotation_name_rot = 90))
```

```{r UpsetPlotVisualzation_OverlapDEGenes_Advanced_8h_Fixed_Meta, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
### GENERATE DATA FRAMES NEEDED TO PLOT DATA ###
# Filter out the genes of interest in 2 different sets
UpsetData_COMB_8h.Fixed.Meta <- c(lapply(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta, FUN = function(stim){(stim%>%
                                                                          filter(Annot == "UP"))[, "Gene"]}),
                       lapply(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta, FUN = function(stim){(stim%>%
                                                                          filter(Annot == "DOWN"))[, "Gene"]}))
names(UpsetData_COMB_8h.Fixed.Meta)<- paste(names(UpsetData_COMB_8h.Fixed.Meta), rep(c("UP", "DOWN"), each = 4), sep = "_")


# Generation of list of downregulated genes per 
UpsetData_COMB_8h.Fixed.Meta <- as.data.frame(list_to_matrix(UpsetData_COMB_8h.Fixed.Meta))

# Check if the expression change is consistent between stimulations
UpsetData_COMB_8h.Fixed.Meta<-UpsetData_COMB_8h.Fixed.Meta%>%
  mutate_at(vars(ends_with("UP")), function(x){ifelse(x==1, "UP", NA)})%>%
  mutate_at(vars(ends_with("DOWN")), function(x){ifelse(x==1, "DOWN", NA)})

# Check if the genes were upregulated/downregulated/mixed over the distinct subsets 
UpsetData_COMB_8h.Fixed.Meta$Direction<-apply(UpsetData_COMB_8h.Fixed.Meta, 1, function(col) {
  u <- unique(na.omit(col))
  if (length(u) == 1) {
    # either "UP" or "DOWN"
    return(u)
  } else if (length(u) > 1) {
    return("MIXED")
  } else {
    # no non-NA values
    return(NA_character_)
  }
})

# Store the genes linked to specific subsets
# stack function creates a data frame from a list
Subsets_8h.Fixed.Meta<-stack(sapply(X = comb_name(UpsetData_SIGN_8h.Fixed.Meta),
                      FUN = function(subset){extract_comb(UpsetData_SIGN_8h.Fixed.Meta, subset)}))
colnames(Subsets_8h.Fixed.Meta) <- c("Genes", "Subset")
UpsetData_COMB_8h.Fixed.Meta <- left_join(x = UpsetData_COMB_8h.Fixed.Meta%>%
                              rownames_to_column(var = "Genes"),
                            y = Subsets_8h.Fixed.Meta,
                            by = "Genes")%>%
  mutate(Direction = factor(Direction, levels = c("MIXED", "UP", "DOWN"),
                               ordered = T))

# Store the table of the distinct directions
UpsetData_COMB_8h.Fixed.Meta.table<-table(UpsetData_COMB_8h.Fixed.Meta$Subset,
                                  UpsetData_COMB_8h.Fixed.Meta$Direction)
```

Generation figure of the final upset plot

```{r PlotUpset_DEGenes_8h_Fixed_Meta, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
### PLOTTING THE DATA USING UPSET PLOT OF COMPLEX HEATMAP ###
# Generate upset plot
upPlot_8h.Fixed.Meta<-
  UpSet(UpsetData_SIGN_8h.Fixed.Meta, comb_order = order(comb_size(UpsetData_SIGN_8h.Fixed.Meta), decreasing = T),
      #  Colors of the dots and balkjes onderaan 
      comb_col = "#595B5C", bg_pt_col = "white",
      # Add plot title
      column_title = "Overlap significant DE genes",
      # Update row annotation (entire set of DEgenes)
      right_annotation = rowAnnotation(
                "DE genes" = anno_barplot(set_size(UpsetData_SIGN_8h.Fixed.Meta),
                                          border = FALSE,
                                          gp = gpar(fill = "#595B5C",
                                                    lty = "blank"), 
                                          add_numbers = T,
                                          width = unit(4, "cm"))),
      # Update column annotation on top of the Upset plot
      top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
                                      # Add barplot based on the direction of the DE genes
                "Intersection size" = anno_barplot(UpsetData_COMB_8h.Fixed.Meta.table,
                                                   border = FALSE,
                                                   # Store correct colors
                                                   gp = gpar(fill = colDirection[colnames(
                                                     UpsetData_COMB_8h.Fixed.Meta.table)],
                                                             lty = "blank"),
                                                   add_numbers = T,
                                                   height = unit(3, "cm")),
                # Annotation name shown at the left side
                annotation_name_side = "left",
                # Rotation of the annotation at the left side
                annotation_name_rot = 90))

# Generate legend
lgd = Legend(
  labels    = colnames(UpsetData_COMB_8h.Fixed.Meta.table),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = colDirection[colnames(UpsetData_COMB_8h.Fixed.Meta.table)]),
  title     = "Direction"
)

# Visualise the upset plot
pdf(file.path(params$path_Results, "DEGAnalysis", paste(params$date3, "Upset_SignDEGenes_Stim_vs_Unstim_8h.pdf", sep = "_")), 
    width=7, height=4)
draw(upPlot_8h.Fixed.Meta,
     annotation_legend_list = list(lgd),
     annotation_legend_side = "left")
```

```{r UpsetPlotVisualzation_OverlapDEGenes_Advanced_30h_Fixed_Meta, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
### GENERATE DATA FRAMES NEEDED TO PLOT DATA ###
# Filter out the genes of interest in 2 different sets
UpsetData_COMB_30h.Fixed.Meta <- c(lapply(DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta, FUN = function(stim){(stim%>%
                                                                          filter(Annot == "UP"))[, "Gene"]}),
                       lapply(DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta, FUN = function(stim){(stim%>%
                                                                          filter(Annot == "DOWN"))[, "Gene"]}))
names(UpsetData_COMB_30h.Fixed.Meta)<- paste(names(UpsetData_COMB_30h.Fixed.Meta), rep(c("UP", "DOWN"), each = 4), sep = "_")


# Generation of list of downregulated genes per 
UpsetData_COMB_30h.Fixed.Meta <- as.data.frame(list_to_matrix(UpsetData_COMB_30h.Fixed.Meta))

# Check if the expression change is consistent between stimulations
UpsetData_COMB_30h.Fixed.Meta<-UpsetData_COMB_30h.Fixed.Meta%>%
  mutate_at(vars(ends_with("UP")), function(x){ifelse(x==1, "UP", NA)})%>%
  mutate_at(vars(ends_with("DOWN")), function(x){ifelse(x==1, "DOWN", NA)})

# Check if the genes were upregulated/downregulated/mixed over the distinct subsets 
UpsetData_COMB_30h.Fixed.Meta$Direction<-apply(UpsetData_COMB_30h.Fixed.Meta, 1, function(col) {
  u <- unique(na.omit(col))
  if (length(u) == 1) {
    # either "UP" or "DOWN"
    return(u)
  } else if (length(u) > 1) {
    return("MIXED")
  } else {
    # no non-NA values
    return(NA_character_)
  }
})

# Store the genes linked to specific subsets
# stack function creates a data frame from a list
Subsets_30h.Fixed.Meta<-stack(sapply(X = comb_name(UpsetData_SIGN_30h.Fixed.Meta),
                      FUN = function(subset){extract_comb(UpsetData_SIGN_30h.Fixed.Meta, subset)}))
colnames(Subsets_30h.Fixed.Meta) <- c("Genes", "Subset")
UpsetData_COMB_30h.Fixed.Meta <- left_join(x = UpsetData_COMB_30h.Fixed.Meta%>%
                              rownames_to_column(var = "Genes"),
                            y = Subsets_30h.Fixed.Meta,
                            by = "Genes")%>%
  mutate(Direction = factor(Direction, levels = c("MIXED", "UP", "DOWN"),
                               ordered = T))

# Store the table of the distinct directions
UpsetData_COMB_30h.Fixed.Meta.table<-table(UpsetData_COMB_30h.Fixed.Meta$Subset,
                                  UpsetData_COMB_30h.Fixed.Meta$Direction)
```

Generation figure of the final upset plot

```{r PlotUpset_DEGenes_30h_Fixed_Meta, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
### PLOTTING THE DATA USING UPSET PLOT OF COMPLEX HEATMAP ###
# Generate upset plot
upPlot_30h.Fixed.Meta<-
  UpSet(UpsetData_SIGN_30h.Fixed.Meta, comb_order = order(comb_size(UpsetData_SIGN_30h.Fixed.Meta), decreasing = T),
      #  Colors of the dots and balkjes onderaan 
      comb_col = "#595B5C", bg_pt_col = "white",
      # Add plot title
      column_title = "Overlap significant DE genes",
      # Update row annotation (entire set of DEgenes)
      right_annotation = rowAnnotation(
                "DE genes" = anno_barplot(set_size(UpsetData_SIGN_30h.Fixed.Meta),
                                          border = FALSE,
                                          gp = gpar(fill = "#595B5C",
                                                    lty = "blank"), 
                                          add_numbers = T,
                                          width = unit(4, "cm"))),
      # Update column annotation on top of the Upset plot
      top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
                                      # Add barplot based on the direction of the DE genes
                "Intersection size" = anno_barplot(UpsetData_COMB_30h.Fixed.Meta.table,
                                                   border = FALSE,
                                                   # Store correct colors
                                                   gp = gpar(fill = colDirection[colnames(
                                                     UpsetData_COMB_30h.Fixed.Meta.table)],
                                                             lty = "blank"),
                                                   add_numbers = T,
                                                   height = unit(3, "cm")),
                # Annotation name shown at the left side
                annotation_name_side = "left",
                # Rotation of the annotation at the left side
                annotation_name_rot = 90))

# Generate legend
lgd = Legend(
  labels    = colnames(UpsetData_COMB_30h.Fixed.Meta.table),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = colDirection[colnames(UpsetData_COMB_30h.Fixed.Meta.table)]),
  title     = "Direction"
)

# Visualise the upset plot
pdf(file.path(params$path_Results, "DEGAnalysis", paste(params$date3, "Upset_SignDEGenes_Stim_vs_Unstim_30h.pdf", sep = "_")), 
    width=7, height=4)
draw(upPlot_30h.Fixed.Meta,
     annotation_legend_list = list(lgd),
     annotation_legend_side = "left")
dev.off()
```

##### Heatmap to test overlap in significant genes 8h vs 30h over stimulations

```{r HeatmapAbsoluteOverlap_8vs30h_Stimulations, fig.height=7, fig.width=8}
# Joining all the differentially expressed genes (not taking into account the direction of expression yet)
DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta<-list("ODN2006_8h" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta$ODN2006%>%
                                                              filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"],
                                                "IFNgamma_8h" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta$IFNgamma%>%
                                                           filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"], 
                                               "MegaCD40L_8h" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta$MegaCD40L%>%
                                                                filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"], 
                                               
                                               "CD3CD28_8h" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta$antiCD3CD28%>%
                                                              filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"],
                                               "ODN2006_30h" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta$ODN2006%>%
                                                              filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"],
                                               "IFNgamma_30h" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta$IFNgamma%>%
                                                           filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"], 
                                               "MegaCD40L_30h" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta$MegaCD40L%>%
                                                                filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"], 
                                               
                                               "CD3CD28_30h" = (DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta$antiCD3CD28%>%
                                                              filter(Annot !="NS"))[, "Gene"]) 
# Calculate overlap
MatOverlap <- sapply(names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta), 
                     function(x) {
                       overlap <- sapply(names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta), function(y) {
                         if (x != y) {
                           intersect(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[x]], 
                                     DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[y]])%>%length()
                           }
                         else (
                           length(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[x]])
                          )
                        })
                      })
# View MatOverlap object
MatOverlap

# Place in heatmap, without reordering of the columns
Heatmap(MatOverlap,
        row_order = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta),
        column_order = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta),
        col = colorRamp2(c(0, 300, 1100), c("white", "#81B9DE", "#0B4AF8")),
        row_names_side = "left", column_names_side = "top",
        cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, col) { 
          # add text to each grid
          grid.text(round(MatOverlap[i, j], digits = 1), x, y)},
        name = "Absolute overlap")
```

```{r HeatmapRelativeOverlap_8vs30h_Stimulations, fig.height=7, fig.width=8}
MatOverlap_Rel<-t(MatOverlap/sapply(colnames(MatOverlap),
       function(col){max(MatOverlap[,col])}))
# Place in heatmap without reordering of the columns
Heatmap(MatOverlap_Rel*100,
        row_order = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta),
        column_order = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta),
        col = colorRamp2(c(0, 50, 100), c("white", "#81B9DE", "#0B4AF8")),
        row_names_side = "left", column_names_side = "top",

          # add text to each grid

        name = "Relative overlap")
# Place in heatmap with reordering of the columns
Heatmap(MatOverlap_Rel*100,
        # row_order = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta),
        # column_order = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta),
        col = colorRamp2(c(0, 50, 100), c("white", "#81B9DE", "#0B4AF8")),
        row_names_side = "left", column_names_side = "top",
        cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, col) { 
          # add text to each grid
          grid.text(round(MatOverlap_Rel[i, j]*100, digits = 1), x, y)},
        name = "Relative overlap")

# Only reorder columns
Heatmap(MatOverlap_Rel*100,
        row_order = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta),
```

### Correlation plots for specific subsets of interest

A first test was performed on the correlation of the gene expression of genes significantly downregulated in ODN2006_8h en ODN2006_30h. 

```{r CorrelationPlot_SelectedConditions}
SubsetGenes_DOWN_ODN2006_8vs30.genes <- intersect(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_DOWN[["ODN2006_8h"]],
                                                  DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_DOWN[["ODN2006_30h"]])

SubsetGenes_UP_ODN2006_8vs30.genes <- intersect(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_UP[["ODN2006_8h"]],
                                                  DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_UP[["ODN2006_30h"]])

SubsetGenes_ODN2006_8vs30.data <- full_join(x = DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta$ODN2006%>%
                                                    filter(Gene %in% c(SubsetGenes_DOWN_ODN2006_8vs30.genes, SubsetGenes_UP_ODN2006_8vs30.genes))%>%
                                                    mutate(Direction = case_when(
                                                      Gene %in% SubsetGenes_DOWN_ODN2006_8vs30.genes ~ "DOWN",
                                                      Gene %in% SubsetGenes_UP_ODN2006_8vs30.genes ~"UP"
                                                    ))%>%
                                                    select(Gene,
                                                           p_val_adj_8h = p_val_adj,
                                                           avg_log2FC_8h = avg_log2FC,
                                                           Direction),
                                                 y = DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta$ODN2006%>%
                                                    filter(Gene %in% c(SubsetGenes_DOWN_ODN2006_8vs30.genes, SubsetGenes_UP_ODN2006_8vs30.genes))%>%
                                                    mutate(Direction = case_when(
                                                            Gene %in% SubsetGenes_DOWN_ODN2006_8vs30.genes ~ "DOWN",
                                                            Gene %in% SubsetGenes_UP_ODN2006_8vs30.genes ~"UP"
                                                    ))%>%
                                                    select(Gene,
                                                           p_val_adj_30h = p_val_adj,
                                                           avg_log2FC_30h = avg_log2FC,
                                                           Direction),
                                                 by = c("Gene", "Direction"))

# Only label the genes based on the absolute difference 
SubsetGenes_ODN2006_8vs30.data<-SubsetGenes_ODN2006_8vs30.data%>%
  mutate(Label = case_when(
    abs(avg_log2FC_8h-avg_log2FC_30h) > 2 ~ Gene,
    TRUE ~ NA
  ))

# Calculate the correlation (Pearson)
SubsetGenes_ODN2006_8vs30.cor<-cor(SubsetGenes_ODN2006_8vs30.data$avg_log2FC_8h,
                                   SubsetGenes_ODN2006_8vs30.data$avg_log2FC_30h,
                                   method = 'pearson')

ggplot(SubsetGenes_ODN2006_8vs30.data,
       mapping = aes(x = avg_log2FC_8h,
                     y = avg_log2FC_30h,
                     color = Direction,
                     label = Label))+
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              color = "grey50")+
  geom_point()+
  geom_text_repel()+
  scale_color_manual(values = colDirection)+
  themeG+
  labs(title = 'ODN2006 - 8h vs.30h',
       subtitle = paste0('Pearson correlation: ', round(SubsetGenes_ODN2006_8vs30.cor, digits = 2)))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 270, vjust=0.5, hjust = 1))
```

### Correlation plots for all subsets

#### Focusing on the expression profiles of all the genes

For this, all the genes are extracted and the logFC expression level (condition vs. unstimulated) are taken into account to calculate the correlation between the expression between particular conditions.

```{r CorelationPlot_AllGenes}
# Merge the lists of differentially expressed genes for both timepoints
DEG_Stim_Unstim_AllTimes_FilClus.Fixed.Meta<-c(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta,
                                               DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta)
# Add suffixes to the original list names
names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_AllTimes_FilClus.Fixed.Meta)<-paste(c(names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta),
                                                            names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_30h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta)),
                                                          rep(c("8h", "30h"), each = 4),
                                                          sep = "_")
# Make sure that the names overlap with the naming in the other objects
names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_AllTimes_FilClus.Fixed.Meta)<-gsub(x = names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_AllTimes_FilClus.Fixed.Meta),
                                                         pattern = "anti", replacement = "")
  
# Use the concatenated list of expression information on all the conditions 
# Including the time point of stimulation
DEG_Stim_Unstim_AllTimes_FilClus.Fixed.Meta.DF<-do.call(rbind, DEG_Stim_Unstim_AllTimes_FilClus.Fixed.Meta)%>%
  # Add the conditions stored in the rownames as an additional column
  rownames_to_column(var = "Condition")%>%
  # Remove the suffix automatically pasted due to need for independent rownamaes
  mutate(Condition = gsub(x = Condition, pattern = "\\..*", replacement = ""))%>%
  # Only retain interest
  select(Condition, Gene, avg_log2FC)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Condition,
              values_from = avg_log2FC)

DEG_Stim_Unstim_AllTimes_FilClus.Fixed.Meta.CorMat<-cor(DEG_Stim_Unstim_AllTimes_FilClus.Fixed.Meta.DF%>%
                                                          select(-Gene))

# Define the colors of interest
colCor<-colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1), c("white", "#81B9C6", "#096180"))
# Heatmap of the correlation
Heatmap(DEG_Stim_Unstim_AllTimes_FilClus.Fixed.Meta.CorMat,
        rect_gp = gpar(type = "none"), 
        cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
        row_names_side = "left",
        # col_names_side = "top",
        col = colCor,
        cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
          if(i<=j) {
            grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = fill, col = fill))
            grid.text(sprintf("%.3f", DEG_Stim_Unstim_AllTimes_FilClus.Fixed.Meta.CorMat[i, j]), 
                      x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10))
            }
          })
```

```{r CorelationPlot_SelectedGenes}
# Initialization of Cor Matrix
DEG_Stim_Unstim_AllTimes_FilClus.Fixed.Meta.CorMat.SelGenes<-matrix(
  nrow = DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_DOWN%>%length(),
  ncol = DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_DOWN%>%length(),
  dimnames = list(names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_DOWN),
                  names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_DOWN)))

#### CORRELATION MATRIX ####
for (stim1 in names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_DOWN)){
  for (stim2 in names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_DOWN)){
    tmp <- DEG_Stim_Unstim_AllTimes_FilClus.Fixed.Meta.DF%>%
      mutate(Direction = case_when(
        # Downregulated and significant in both cases
        .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_DOWN[[stim1]],
                                       DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_DOWN[[stim2]]) ~ "DOWN",
        # Upregulated and significant in both cases
        .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_UP[[stim1]],
                                       DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_UP[[stim2]]) ~ "UP",
        # Mixes and significant
        .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_DOWN[[stim1]],
                                       DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_UP[[stim2]]) ~ "MIXED",
        .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_UP[[stim1]],
                                       DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_DOWN[[stim2]]) ~ "MIXED",
        # Other genes are not significant
        TRUE ~ "NS")
      )%>%
      filter(Direction!="NS")
    
    # This line should be run if problems arise due to inconsistency with namings
    # colnames(tmp)<-gsub(x = colnames(tmp), pattern = "CD3", replacement = "antiCD3")
    
    # Store correlation
    DEG_Stim_Unstim_AllTimes_FilClus.Fixed.Meta.CorMat.SelGenes[stim1,stim2]<-cor(x = tmp[[stim1]], 
                                                                                  y = tmp[[stim2]],
                                                                                  method = "pearson")
  }
}
    
#### VISUALIZATION IN HEATMAP ####

        col = colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1), c("white", "#81B9C6", "#096180")),
        cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
          if(i<=j) {
            grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = fill, col = fill))
            grid.text(sprintf("%.3f", DEG_Stim_Unstim_AllTimes_FilClus.Fixed.Meta.CorMat.SelGenes[i, j]), 
                      x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, col = "white"))
            }
          },
        right_annotation = rowAnnotation(set=anno_text(colnames(DEG_Stim_Unstim_AllTimes_FilClus.Fixed.Meta.CorMat.SelGenes))),
        top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(set=anno_text(colnames(DEG_Stim_Unstim_AllTimes_FilClus.Fixed.Meta.CorMat.SelGenes),
                                                         location = 0, just="left", rot = 45)))
```

```{r Corelation_Scatter_DensityPlot_AllGenes, fig.width=20, fig.height=20}
labelCutOff<-2
#### SCATTER PLOT + LABELING ####
plot_lower_scatter.ggpairs<-function(data, mapping, thres=log2FC_thres,
                             labelThres=labelCutOff,
                             DEG_Selected_DOWN, DEG_Selected_UP){
  
  # Extract the names of the columns present on the x and y axis
  x_name<-as_label(mapping$x)
  y_name<-as_label(mapping$y)
  
  tmp <- data%>%
    mutate(Direction = case_when(
      # Downregulated and significant in both cases
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_DOWN[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_DOWN[[y_name]]) ~ "DOWN",
      # Upregulated and significant in both cases
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_UP[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_UP[[y_name]]) ~ "UP",
      # Mixes and significant
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_DOWN[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_UP[[y_name]]) ~ "MIXED",
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_UP[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_DOWN[[y_name]]) ~ "MIXED",
      # Other genes are not significant
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    ),
    label = case_when(
      # Downregulated and significant in both cases
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_DOWN[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_DOWN[[y_name]]) & 
        # Only show if the difference form the bisector is large enough
        abs(.data[[x_name]] - .data[[y_name]]) > labelThres ~ Gene,
      # Upregulated and significant in both cases
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_UP[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_UP[[y_name]]) & 
        # Only show if the difference form the bisector is large enough
        abs(.data[[x_name]] - .data[[y_name]]) > labelThres ~ Gene,
      # Mixes and significant
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_DOWN[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_UP[[y_name]]) &
        # Only show if the difference form the bisector is large enough
        abs(.data[[x_name]] - .data[[y_name]]) > labelThres ~ Gene,
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_UP[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_DOWN[[y_name]]) &
        # Only show if the difference form the bisector is large enough
        abs(.data[[x_name]] - .data[[y_name]]) > labelThres ~ Gene,
      # Other genes are not significant
      TRUE ~ NA
    ))
  
  # Plotting the data using a scatter plot
  ggplot(tmp, mapping = aes(x = .data[[x_name]],
                            y = .data[[y_name]],
                            color = Direction,
                            shape = Direction,
                            alpha = Direction,
                            label = label))+
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              color = "grey50")+
    geom_point(size = 1)+
    geom_label_repel(label.padding = 0.1, 
                   box.padding = 1.5,
                   min.segment.length = 0,
                   position = "jitter",
                   max.overlaps = 20)+
    scale_color_manual(values = colDirection)+
    scale_shape_manual(values = shapeDirection)+
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("DOWN" = 1,
                                  "UP" = 1,
                                  "MIXED" = 1,
                                  "NS" = 0.1))+
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(-10,10), breaks=seq(-10,10, by = 5))+
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-10,10), breaks=seq(-10,10, by = 5))
  }

#### DENSITY PLOT ####
plot_diag_density.ggpairs<-function(data, mapping, thres=log2FC_thres,
                                     labelThres=labelCutOff,
                                     DEG_Selected_DOWN, DEG_Selected_UP){
  # Extract the names of the columns present on the x and y axis
  x_name<-as_label(mapping$x)
  
  tmp <- data%>%
    mutate(Direction = case_when(
      # Downregulated and significant in both cases
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% DEG_Selected_DOWN[[x_name]] ~ "DOWN",
      # Upregulated and significant in both cases
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% DEG_Selected_UP[[x_name]] ~ "UP",
      # Other genes are not significant
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    ))
  
  # Plotting the data
  ggplot(data = tmp, 
         mapping = aes(x = .data[[x_name]], 
                       fill = Direction, 
                       color = Direction))+
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5)+
    scale_fill_manual(values = colDirection) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = colDirection) + 
    theme_minimal()+
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,2), breaks=seq(0,2, by = 0.5))+
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-10,10), breaks=seq(-10,10, by = 5))
}

#### CORRELATION CALCULATION ####
plot_upper_correlation.ggpairs <- function(data, mapping,
                             DEG_Selected_DOWN, DEG_Selected_UP){
  
  # Extract the names of the columns present on the x and y axis
  x_name<-as_label(mapping$x)
  y_name<-as_label(mapping$y)

  tmp <- data%>%
    mutate(Direction = case_when(
      # Downregulated and significant in both cases
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_DOWN[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_DOWN[[y_name]]) ~ "DOWN",
      # Upregulated and significant in both cases
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_UP[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_UP[[y_name]]) ~ "UP",
      # Mixes and significant
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_DOWN[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_UP[[y_name]]) ~ "MIXED",
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_UP[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_DOWN[[y_name]]) ~ "MIXED",
      # Other genes are not significant
      TRUE ~ "NS"))
  
  # Store correlation
  tmp_cor<-cor(x = tmp[[x_name]], y = tmp[[y_name]],
             method = "pearson")
  
  # Plot the output
  ggplot() + 
    annotate(geom = "text",
             x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
             label = sprintf("Corr: \n %.3f", tmp_cor),
             size = 6)+
    theme_void()
  }

#### COMBINING PLOTS ####
ggpairs(DEG_Stim_Unstim_AllTimes_FilClus.Fixed.Meta.DF,
        columns = 2:dim(DEG_Stim_Unstim_AllTimes_FilClus.Fixed.Meta.DF)[2],
        lower = list(continuous = GGally::wrap(plot_lower_scatter.ggpairs, thres = log2FC_thres,
                                               DEG_Selected_DOWN=DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_DOWN,
                                               DEG_Selected_UP=DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_UP)),
        diag = list(continuous = GGally::wrap(plot_diag_density.ggpairs,
                                              thres = log2FC_thres,
                                              DEG_Selected_DOWN=DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_DOWN,
                                              DEG_Selected_UP=DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_UP)),
        upper = list(continuous = GGally::wrap(plot_upper_correlation.ggpairs,
                                               DEG_Selected_DOWN=DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_DOWN,
                                              DEG_Selected_UP=DEG_Stim_Unstim_8hvs30_FilClus.Fixed.Meta_UP)))
```

```{r Corelation_Scatter_DensityPlot_AllGenes, fig.width=20, fig.height=20}
        abs(.data[[x_name]] - .data[[y_name]]) > labelThres ~ Gene,
      # Upregulated and significant in both cases
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_UP[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_UP[[y_name]]) & 
        # Only show if the difference form the bisector is large enough
        abs(.data[[x_name]] - .data[[y_name]]) > labelThres ~ Gene,
      # Mixes and significant
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_DOWN[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_UP[[y_name]]) &
        # Only show if the difference form the bisector is large enough
        abs(.data[[x_name]] - .data[[y_name]]) > labelThres ~ Gene,
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_UP[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_DOWN[[y_name]]) &
        # Only show if the difference form the bisector is large enough
        abs(.data[[x_name]] - .data[[y_name]]) > labelThres ~ Gene,
      # Other genes are not significant
      TRUE ~ NA
    ))%>%
    filter(Direction!="NS")
  
  # Plotting the data using a scatter plot
  ggplot(tmp, mapping = aes(x = .data[[x_name]],
                            y = .data[[y_name]],
                            color = Direction,
                            shape = Direction,
                            alpha = Direction,
                            label = label))+
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              color = "grey50")+
    geom_point(size = 1)+
    geom_label_repel(label.padding = 0.1, 
                   box.padding = 1.5,
                   min.segment.length = 0,
                   position = "jitter",
                   max.overlaps = 20)+
    scale_color_manual(values = colDirection)+
    scale_shape_manual(values = shapeDirection)+
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("DOWN" = 1,
                                  "UP" = 1,
                                  "MIXED" = 1,
                                  "NS" = 0.1))+
    theme_minimal()+
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(-10,10), breaks=seq(-10,10, by = 5))+
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-10,10), breaks=seq(-10,10, by = 5))
  }

#### DENSITY PLOT ####
plot_diag_density_SelGenes.ggpairs<-function(data, mapping, thres=log2FC_thres,
                                     labelThres=labelCutOff,
                                     DEG_Selected_DOWN, DEG_Selected_UP){
  # Extract the names of the columns present on the x and y axis
  x_name<-as_label(mapping$x)
  
  tmp <- data%>%
    mutate(Direction = case_when(
      # Downregulated and significant in both cases
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% DEG_Selected_DOWN[[x_name]] ~ "DOWN",
      # Upregulated and significant in both cases
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% DEG_Selected_UP[[x_name]] ~ "UP",
      # Other genes are not significant
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    ))%>%
    filter(Direction != "NS")
  
  # Plotting the data
  ggplot(data = tmp, 
         mapping = aes(x = .data[[x_name]], 
                       fill = Direction, 
                       color = Direction))+
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5)+
    scale_fill_manual(values = colDirection) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = colDirection) + 
    theme_minimal()+
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,2), breaks=seq(0, 2, by = 0.5))+
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-10,10), breaks=seq(-10,10, by = 5))
}

#### CORRELATION CALCULATION ####
plot_upper_correlation_SelGenes.ggpairs <- function(data, mapping,
                             DEG_Selected_DOWN, DEG_Selected_UP){
  
  # Extract the names of the columns present on the x and y axis
  x_name<-as_label(mapping$x)
  y_name<-as_label(mapping$y)

  tmp <- data%>%
    mutate(Direction = case_when(
      # Downregulated and significant in both cases
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_DOWN[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_DOWN[[y_name]]) ~ "DOWN",
      # Upregulated and significant in both cases
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_UP[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_UP[[y_name]]) ~ "UP",
      # Mixes and significant
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_DOWN[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_UP[[y_name]]) ~ "MIXED",
      .data[["Gene"]] %in% intersect(DEG_Selected_UP[[x_name]], DEG_Selected_DOWN[[y_name]]) ~ "MIXED",
      # Other genes are not significant
      TRUE ~ "NS")
    )%>%
    filter(Direction!="NS")
  
  # Store correlation
  tmp_cor<-cor(x = tmp[[x_name]], y = tmp[[y_name]],
             method = "pearson")
  
  # Plot the output
  ggplot() + 
    annotate(geom = "text",
             x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
             label = sprintf("Corr: \n %.3f", tmp_cor),
             size = 6)+
    theme_void()
  }
```

## Hypergeometric testing of gene sets enrichment

### `phyper` HGT testing

```{r}
# Gene ontology - Biological processes
GeneSets_GO_BP<-msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C5", subcategory = "BP")%>%
  # Select only the columns of interest for downstream analysis
  select(gs_name, gene_symbol, gs_description)

# Make sure no duplicates of genes are retained in the genesets
GeneSets_GO_BP<-GeneSets_GO_BP%>%
  subset(!duplicated(GeneSets_GO_BP[, c("gs_name", "gene_symbol")]))

# Select only the genes that are present in our dataset
GeneSets_GO_BP<-GeneSets_GO_BP%>%
  filter(gene_symbol %in% DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta$IFNgamma[["Gene"]])
```

#### 8h stimulation

```{r Phyper_HGT_GOSets_8h_Fixed_Meta}
# Save the total number of genes in the entire dataset
totalGeneNumber<-length(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta$IFNgamma$Gene)

# Initialization of dataframa that will be filled in using the following code
GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta <- as.data.frame(matrix(nrow=length(unique(GeneSets_GO_BP$gs_name)),ncol=1))
GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta$GeneSet <-unique(GeneSets_GO_BP$gs_name)
GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta<- GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta%>%column_to_rownames(var = "GeneSet")


# For-loop over the pathways of interest
for (pathway in GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta%>%rownames()){
  # Extract the genes of the pathway of interest
  pathway.genes<-(GeneSets_GO_BP%>%filter(gs_name == pathway))[['gene_symbol']]
  
  # For-loop over the distinct subsets
  for(stim in names(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta)){
           # Initialization of names
           overlapUP.var<-paste("Overlap",stim, "UP", sep = "_")
           overlapUP.pval<-paste("pval", stim, "UP", sep = "_")
           overlapDOWN.var<-paste("Overlap",stim, "DOWN", sep = "_")
           overlapDOWN.pval<-paste("pval", stim, "DOWN", sep = "_")
           # Extract subset of interest
           subsetUP<-(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]%>%
             filter(Annot == "UP"))[["Gene"]]
           subsetDOWN<-(DEG_Stim_Unstim_8h_FilClus.Fixed.Meta[[stim]]%>%
             filter(Annot == "DOWN"))[["Gene"]]
           # Check overlap + store in the final dataframe
           overlapUP<-length(intersect(pathway.genes, subsetUP))
           GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta[pathway, overlapUP.var]<-overlapUP
           overlapDOWN<-length(intersect(pathway.genes, subsetDOWN))
           GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta[pathway, overlapDOWN.var]<-overlapDOWN
           
           # Perform hypergeometric testing for upregulated genes
           GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta[pathway, overlapUP.pval]<-phyper(q = overlapUP - 1,
                                                       m = length(pathway.genes),
                                                       n = totalGeneNumber-length(pathway.genes),
                                                       k = length(subsetUP),
                                                       lower.tail = F)
           # Perform hypergeometric testing for downregulated genes
           GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta[pathway, overlapDOWN.pval]<-phyper(q = overlapDOWN - 1,
                                                       m = length(pathway.genes),
                                                       n = totalGeneNumber-length(pathway.genes),
                                                       k = length(subsetDOWN),
                                                       lower.tail = F)
           }
}

# Remove the unnecessary columns
GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta[["V1"]]<-NULL
```

```{r IncubTime_Phyper_HGT_MultipleTestingCorrection_GOSets_PerStim_Fixed_Meta}
# Multiple testing correction with Benjamini Hochberg
for(col in grep(pattern = "^pval", x = names(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta), value = T)){
  new_colname <- paste0('adj', col)
  GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta[,new_colname] <- p.adjust(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta[,col], method = "BH")
}

GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta%>%head()
```

```{r IncubTime_Phyper_HGT_MultipleTestingCorrection_GOSets_PerStim_Fixed_Meta}
# Multiple testing correction with Benjamini Hochberg
for(col in grep(pattern = "^pval", x = names(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.30h.Fixed.Meta), value = T)){
  new_colname <- paste0('adj', col)
  GSE_HGT_GO_BP.30h.Fixed.Meta[,new_colname] <- p.adjust(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.30h.Fixed.Meta[,col], method = "BH")
}

GSE_HGT_GO_BP.30h.Fixed.Meta%>%head()
```

## Visualization of interesting gene sets

### Upsetplots 

```{r UpsetPlot_GeneSets}
# Define significance level
sign_level<-0.05

# Extract only the significant GSE after HGT
# Only focus on significantly different genes
UpsetData_SIGN_GSE.Fixed <- c(lapply(X = grep(pattern = "adjpval",
                                            x = colnames(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta),
                                            value = T),
                                   FUN = function(col){
                                     rownames(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta)[GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta[, col]<=sign_level]
                                   }),
                              lapply(X = grep(pattern = "adjpval",
                                            x = colnames(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.30h.Fixed.Meta),
                                            value = T),
                                   FUN = function(col){
```

### Dotplots

First, select the interesting gene sets. In this case the `topGSE` gene sets are selected per stimulation for downstream visualisation. This is performed for both 8h and 30h of stimulation.

```{r DotPlost_GSEA_Visualization_8h_30h_Fixed_Meta_DataSelection}
#### DATA SELECTION ####
topGSE = 10

#### 8h ####
# Extracting the most interesting gene sets based on the top 20 per subset
for (stim_dir in grep(pattern = "adjpval", x = names(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta), value = T)){
  top20GSE_stim <- head(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta%>%
                                      # Only extract the top 10 of the upregulated genes
                                     arrange(.data[[stim_dir]]), n = topGSE)%>%rownames
  
  # Store only the top 10 down/upregulated genes in a dataframe
  # First check if the dataframe is does exist or is empyt
  if (!exists("top20GSE_total.8h.Fixed.Meta") || length(top20GSE_total.8h.Fixed.Meta) == 0){
    message("Creating vector")
    top20GSE_total.8h.Fixed.Meta <- top20GSE_stim
  } else {
    message("\nJoining additional gene sets")
    # Adding additional genes if they are not yet present in the top20GSE list
   top20GSE_total.8h.Fixed.Meta <- unique(c(top20GSE_total.8h.Fixed.Meta, top20GSE_stim))
  }
  # Clean memory
  rm(top20GSE_stim)
}

#### 30h ####
# Extracting the most interesting gene sets based on the top 20 per subset
for (stim_dir in grep(pattern = "adjpval", x = names(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.30h.Fixed.Meta), value = T)){
  top20GSE_stim <- head(GSE_HGT_GO_BP.30h.Fixed.Meta%>%
                                      # Only extract the top 10 of the upregulated genes
                                     arrange(.data[[stim_dir]]), n = topGSE)%>%rownames
  
  # Store only the top 10 down/upregulated genes in a dataframe
  # First check if the dataframe is does exist or is empyt
  if (!exists("top20GSE_total.30h.Fixed.Meta") || length(top20GSE_total.30h.Fixed.Meta) == 0){
    message("Creating vector")
    top20GSE_total.30h.Fixed.Meta <- top20GSE_stim
  } else {
    message("\nJoining additional gene sets")
    # Adding additional genes if they are not yet present in the top20GSE list
   top20GSE_total.30h.Fixed.Meta <- unique(c(top20GSE_total.30h.Fixed.Meta, top20GSE_stim))
  }
  # Clean memory
  rm(top20GSE_stim)
}

```


```{r DotPlot_GSEA_Visualization_8h_30h_HardCutOffs_Meta, fig.height=15, fig.width=15}
#### DOTPLOT ####
GSE_HGT_GO_BP.Combined.Fixed.Meta<-unique(c(top20GSE_total.8h.Fixed.Meta, top20GSE_total.30h.Fixed.Meta))
# Prepare data
dotPlot.Data.Fixed.Meta<-rbind(
  # Extract data for 8 hours of stimulation
  full_join(
  # Extract the adjusted pvalues
  (GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta[GSE_HGT_GO_BP.Combined.Fixed.Meta,])%>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "GeneSet")%>%
    # Only select columns with adjusted Pvalue and overlap with gene set
    select("GeneSet", starts_with("adjpval"))%>%
    # Transform to longer format
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("adjpval"),
                 names_to = "Stimulation",
                 values_to = "AdjPval")%>%
    mutate(Stimulation = gsub(pattern = "adjpval_", replacement = "", Stimulation)),
  # Extract the overlap
  (GSE_HGT_GO_BP.8h.Fixed.Meta[GSE_HGT_GO_BP.Combined.Fixed.Meta,])%>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "GeneSet")%>%
    # Only select columns with adjusted Pvalue and overlap with gene set
    select("GeneSet", starts_with("Overlap"))%>%
    # Transform to longer format
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Overlap"),
                 names_to = "Stimulation",
                 values_to = "Overlap")%>%
    mutate(Stimulation = gsub(pattern = "Overlap_", replacement = "", Stimulation)),
  by = c('GeneSet', 'Stimulation'))%>%
    # Mark that these are the values for 8 hours of stimulation
    mutate(TimePoint = 8),
  
  # Extract data for 30h
  full_join(
  # Extract the adjusted pvalues
  (GSE_HGT_GO_BP.30h.Fixed.Meta[GSE_HGT_GO_BP.Combined.Fixed.Meta,])%>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "GeneSet")%>%
    # Only select columns with adjusted Pvalue and overlap with gene set
    select("GeneSet", starts_with("adjpval"))%>%
    # Transform to longer format
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("adjpval"),
                 names_to = "Stimulation",
                 values_to = "AdjPval")%>%
    mutate(Stimulation = gsub(pattern = "adjpval_", replacement = "", Stimulation)),
  # Extract the overlap
  (GSE_HGT_GO_BP.30h.Fixed.Meta[GSE_HGT_GO_BP.Combined.Fixed.Meta,])%>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "GeneSet")%>%
    # Only select columns with adjusted Pvalue and overlap with gene set
    select("GeneSet", starts_with("Overlap"))%>%
    # Transform to longer format
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Overlap"),
                 names_to = "Stimulation",
                 values_to = "Overlap")%>%
    mutate(Stimulation = gsub(pattern = "Overlap_", replacement = "", Stimulation)),
  by = c('GeneSet', 'Stimulation'))%>%
    # Mark that these are the values for 8 hours of stimulation
    mutate(TimePoint = 30)
  )%>%
  # Arrange the GSE names
  mutate(GeneSet = fct_reorder(GeneSet, AdjPval, .desc = TRUE),
        # Indicate in which timepoint this GSE was selected in top 20
         SelectIn = case_when(
           GeneSet %in% top20GSE_total.8h.Fixed.Meta & TimePoint == 8 ~ "8",
           GeneSet %in% top20GSE_total.30h.Fixed.Meta & TimePoint == 30 ~ "30",
           TRUE ~ NA
         ))%>%
  mutate(SelectIn = factor(SelectIn,
                            levels = c("8", "30"),
                            ordered = T))

dotPlot.Data.Fixed.Meta<-dotPlot.Data.Fixed.Meta%>%
  mutate(Stimulation = factor(Stimulation,
                              levels = paste(c("ODN2006", "IFNgamma", "antiCD3CD28", "MegaCD40L"), rep(c("UP", "DOWN"), each = 4), sep = "_"),
                              order = T))


# Plot data
(ggplot(data = dotPlot.Data.Fixed.Meta[!is.na(dotPlot.Data.Fixed.Meta$SelectIn),])+
   geom_tile(mapping = aes(x = SelectIn,
                           y = GeneSet),
             na.rm = T, fill = "grey65")+
    themeG+theme(axis.title = element_blank())+
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top"))+
(ggplot(data = dotPlot.Data.Fixed.Meta)+
  geom_vline(mapping = aes(xintercept = Stimulation),
             color = "grey80", 
             alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_hline(mapping = aes(yintercept = GeneSet),
             color = "grey80", 
             alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = Stimulation,
                     y = GeneSet,
                     size = Overlap,
                     fill  = -log10(AdjPval)),
             shape = 21, color = "grey50")+
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("white", "lightblue", "darkblue", "#04074E"),
                        breaks = c(0, 40, 70),
                        values = c(0, 0.05, 0.50, 0.95, 1))+
  scale_size(range = c(0,6))+
  themeG+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   vjust = 1, hjust = 0), 
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank())+
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top")+
  facet_grid(.~TimePoint)+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank()))+
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 6))+ 
  plot_annotation(title = "Hard Cutoffs for Nhood selection")
```

### Check similarity between most interesting gene sets

To check similarity between gene set, the overlap in genes is extracted and visualized.

```{r OverlapGenes_GeneSets, fig.width=30, fig.height=30}
# Check overlap in genes within gene sets
Overlap_mat <- matrix(nrow = length(unique(dotPlot.Data.Fixed.Meta$GeneSet)),
                      ncol = length(unique(dotPlot.Data.Fixed.Meta$GeneSet)),
                      dimnames = list(unique(dotPlot.Data.Fixed.Meta$GeneSet),
                                      unique(dotPlot.Data.Fixed.Meta$GeneSet)))

for (col in colnames(Overlap_mat)){
  for (row in rownames(Overlap_mat)){
    Overlap_mat[row, col] <- sum((GeneSets_GO_BP%>%filter(gs_name == col))[['gene_symbol']] %in% (GeneSets_GO_BP%>%filter(gs_name == row))[['gene_symbol']])
  }
}

Overlap_mat.order =  hclust(dist(Overlap_mat))$order

Overlap_mat.reorderd = Overlap_mat[Overlap_mat.order, Overlap_mat.order]

Overlap_mat.HT<-
  Heatmap(Overlap_mat.reorderd, 
        rect_gp = gpar(type = "none"), 
        cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
        row_names_side = "left",
        cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
          if(i >= j) {
            grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = fill, col = fill))
            }
          })

draw(Overlap_mat.HT, padding = unit(c(200, 200, 2, 2), "mm"))
```
